tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.description: AI chatbot for conversation, writing, coding, and analysis.
tools.longDescription: ChatGPT by OpenAI is the most widely used AI assistant in the world. It can help with writing, coding, brainstorming, research, math, and creative tasks. Supports text, image, and file inputs with GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 models. Features include custom GPTs, DALL-E image generation, web browsing, and code execution.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with GPT-4o mini. Plus at $20/mo. Pro at $200/mo.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: Anthropic's AI assistant — thoughtful, safe, and great at long documents.
tools.longDescription: Claude by Anthropic is known for nuanced reasoning, safety, and handling long documents up to 200K tokens. Excels at analysis, writing, coding, and research. Features include artifact creation, computer use, and the Claude Code CLI for developers. Available via API and claude.ai.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Pro at $20/mo. Max at $100/mo for heavy usage.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.description: AI image generator known for stunning artistic and photorealistic outputs.
tools.longDescription: Midjourney is the leading AI image generation tool, producing breathtaking artwork, illustrations, and photorealistic images from text prompts. Known for exceptional aesthetic quality. Accessible through Discord and the Midjourney web app. Supports image editing, variations, and upscaling.
tools.pricingDetails: Basic at $10/mo. Standard at $30/mo. Pro at $60/mo.

tools.name: Cursor Agent Mode
tools.description: Autonomous AI agent in Cursor IDE that implements features end-to-end.
tools.longDescription: Cursor's Agent mode provides an autonomous AI coding assistant that can implement entire features. It creates files, runs terminal commands, debugs errors, and iterates on solutions. Works across your full codebase with multi-file editing and intelligent context gathering.
cons: Can make mistakes on complex tasks

tools.name: Perplexity
tools.description: AI-powered search engine with cited sources and real-time answers.
tools.longDescription: Perplexity is an AI search engine that provides direct answers with cited sources. It combines web search with AI reasoning to deliver accurate, up-to-date information. Features include follow-up questions, collections, and Pro Search for deeper research. Great alternative to traditional search engines.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with basic search. Pro at $20/mo for advanced models.
tools.founder: Aravind Srinivas, Denis Yarats, Johnny Ho, Andy Konwinski
cons: Pro Search limited on free tier

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.description: AI voice generation and cloning with ultra-realistic speech synthesis.
tools.longDescription: ElevenLabs offers the most realistic AI voice generation available. Features include text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice design, and dubbing. Used for audiobooks, podcasts, videos, and accessibility. Supports 29 languages with natural intonation and emotion.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 10K characters/mo. Starter at $5/mo. Creator at $22/mo.

tools.name: Runway
tools.description: AI video generation and editing — create videos from text and images.
tools.longDescription: Runway is a leading AI video generation platform. Gen-3 Alpha produces high-quality video from text prompts and images. Also offers video-to-video transformation, motion tracking, background removal, and other creative AI tools. Used by filmmakers, content creators, and marketers.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with limited credits. Standard at $12/mo. Pro at $28/mo.
tools.founder: Cristóbal Valenzuela, Alejandro Matamala, Anastasis Germanidis

tools.name: Jasper
tools.description: AI marketing platform for brand-consistent content at scale.
tools.longDescription: Jasper is an AI content platform designed for marketing teams. It generates blog posts, social media content, ad copy, and emails while maintaining brand voice consistency. Features include brand memory, campaign workflows, and team collaboration. Integrates with popular marketing tools.
tools.pricingDetails: Creator at $49/mo. Pro at $69/mo. Business pricing custom.
tools.founder: Dave Rogenmoser, Chris Hull, John Philip Morgan

tools.name: Gemini
tools.description: Google's AI assistant with deep search integration and multimodal capabilities.
tools.longDescription: Gemini is Google's flagship AI assistant, powered by the Gemini model family. It excels at reasoning, coding, and multimodal tasks including image and video understanding. Deeply integrated with Google Workspace, Search, and Android. Features include Gems (custom assistants), real-time web access, and long context windows up to 1M tokens.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Advanced at $20/mo with Google One AI Premium.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.description: AI pair programmer that suggests code in real-time inside your editor.
tools.longDescription: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant built into VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, and more. It provides inline code completions, chat-based coding help, and pull request summaries. Powered by OpenAI models and trained on billions of lines of code. Features include multi-file editing, workspace context, and Copilot Extensions.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier for open source. Individual at $10/mo. Business at $19/mo.
tools.freeTrial: Free for students and OSS maintainers

tools.name: DALL-E
tools.description: OpenAI's image generator — create and edit images from text descriptions.
tools.longDescription: DALL-E by OpenAI generates high-quality images from natural language prompts. DALL-E 3 produces highly detailed, accurate images that closely follow complex prompts. Integrated into ChatGPT and available via API. Supports inpainting, outpainting, and variations. Known for strong text rendering and prompt adherence.
tools.pricingDetails: Included in ChatGPT Plus ($20/mo). API pricing per image from $0.04.

tools.name: Stable Diffusion
tools.description: Open-source AI image generation you can run locally or in the cloud.
tools.longDescription: Stable Diffusion by Stability AI is the leading open-source image generation model. It can be run locally on consumer hardware or accessed via cloud APIs. Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting, and ControlNet for precise control. Massive community with thousands of fine-tuned models, LoRAs, and extensions on Civitai and Hugging Face.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open source. Stability AI API from $0.01/image. DreamStudio credits available.

tools.name: Notion AI
tools.description: AI writing and knowledge assistant built into your Notion workspace.
tools.longDescription: Notion AI is deeply integrated into the Notion workspace, helping you write, summarize, brainstorm, and find information across your docs and databases. It can draft content, translate text, extract action items, and answer questions about your workspace. Works seamlessly with Notion's pages, databases, and projects.
tools.pricingDetails: Add-on at $10/member/mo on top of any Notion plan.

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.description: AI writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and style improvements.
tools.longDescription: Grammarly is the most popular AI writing assistant, used by over 30 million people. It checks grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and tone in real-time. The AI-powered generative features can rewrite, compose, and ideate. Works across browsers, desktop apps, and mobile. Integrates with Google Docs, Microsoft Office, and more.
tools.pricingDetails: Free basic checks. Premium at $12/mo. Business at $15/member/mo.
tools.founder: Alex Shevchenko, Max Lytvyn, Dmytro Lider
cons: Can be overly aggressive with suggestions

tools.name: Copy.ai
tools.description: AI-powered marketing copy and content generation for go-to-market teams.
tools.longDescription: Copy.ai is an AI platform for marketing and sales teams. It generates ad copy, blog posts, social media content, product descriptions, and email sequences. Features include workflows for automating content pipelines, brand voice training, and integrations with CRMs and marketing tools. Used by enterprise GTM teams for scaling content production.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 2,000 words/mo. Pro at $49/mo. Enterprise custom pricing.

tools.name: Synthesia
tools.description: Create professional AI videos with realistic avatars — no camera needed.
tools.longDescription: Synthesia lets you create professional videos using AI avatars that speak any script in 140+ languages. No filming, actors, or equipment required. Choose from 230+ diverse avatars or create a custom digital twin. Used for training videos, marketing content, and internal communications by companies like Xerox, Reuters, and Zoom.
tools.pricingDetails: Starter at $18/mo. Creator at $64/mo. Enterprise custom pricing.
tools.founder: Victor Riparbelli, Steffen Tjerrild, Matthias Niessner, Lourdes Agapito

tools.name: Descript
tools.description: AI video and audio editor — edit media by editing text transcripts.
tools.longDescription: Descript is a revolutionary video and audio editor that lets you edit media by editing its transcript. Features include AI-powered filler word removal, eye contact correction, background noise removal, studio sound enhancement, and AI voice cloning for overdubs. Perfect for podcasters, YouTubers, and content creators who want fast, intuitive editing.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 1 hour of transcription. Hobbyist at $24/mo. Pro at $33/mo.

tools.name: Canva AI
tools.description: AI-powered design platform for creating graphics, presentations, and social media content.
tools.longDescription: Canva AI brings artificial intelligence into the world's most popular design platform. Magic Studio features include Magic Design (generate designs from prompts), Magic Write (AI copywriting), Magic Edit (AI image editing), Magic Eraser, and text-to-image generation. Makes professional design accessible to everyone with AI-powered templates and tools.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Pro at $13/mo. Teams at $10/person/mo.
tools.founder: Melanie Perkins, Cliff Obrecht, Cameron Adams

tools.name: Figma AI
tools.description: AI features inside Figma for faster UI design, prototyping, and asset generation.
tools.longDescription: Figma AI integrates artificial intelligence directly into the leading collaborative design tool. Features include AI-powered design generation, layer renaming, asset search, content rewriting, and prototype flow suggestions. Helps designers move faster from ideation to polished UI. Available as part of the Figma platform for product and UI/UX teams.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for individuals. Professional at $15/editor/mo. Organization at $45/editor/mo.

tools.name: Suno
tools.description: AI music generator — create full songs with vocals from text prompts.
tools.longDescription: Suno is an AI music generation platform that creates complete songs with vocals, instruments, and production from simple text descriptions. Generate any genre from pop to jazz to electronic. Features include custom lyrics, style control, song extension, and remix capabilities. Used by musicians, content creators, and hobbyists to bring musical ideas to life instantly.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 10 songs/day. Pro at $10/mo with 500 songs. Premier at $30/mo.
tools.founder: Mikey Shulman, Georg Kucsko, Martin Camacho, Keenan Freyberg

tools.name: Udio
tools.description: AI music creation tool that generates high-quality tracks with realistic vocals.
tools.longDescription: Udio is an AI music generation platform that produces studio-quality songs from text prompts. Known for realistic vocal quality and musical coherence across genres. Features include inpainting, audio-to-audio remixing, and fine-grained control over song structure. Backed by top music industry investors and used by producers and creators worldwide.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited generations. Standard at $10/mo. Pro at $30/mo.
tools.founder: David Ding, Andrew Sanchez, Conor Durkan, Nash Borges

tools.name: Replit
tools.description: AI-powered cloud IDE — build, run, and deploy apps from your browser.
tools.longDescription: Replit is a browser-based IDE with powerful AI coding features. Replit Agent can build full-stack applications from natural language descriptions. Features include AI code completion, instant deployment, collaborative multiplayer editing, and support for 50+ programming languages. No setup required — just describe what you want to build and ship it.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Replit Core at $25/mo. Teams at $40/mo.

tools.name: v0 by Vercel
tools.description: AI UI generator — describe a component and get production-ready React code.
tools.longDescription: v0 by Vercel is an AI-powered UI generation tool that creates production-ready React components from text descriptions and images. It generates clean code using shadcn/ui, Tailwind CSS, and Next.js conventions. Features include iterative refinement, code export, and one-click deployment to Vercel. Perfect for rapidly prototyping and building polished frontends.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited generations. Premium at $20/mo. Team at $30/mo.

tools.name: Bolt
tools.description: AI full-stack app builder — prompt to working app in seconds.
tools.longDescription: Bolt by StackBlitz is an AI-powered full-stack web development tool that builds complete applications from natural language prompts. It runs a full development environment in the browser with real-time preview. Supports multiple frameworks including React, Next.js, Vue, and Svelte. Features include iterative refinement, package management, and deployment.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Pro at $20/mo with higher limits. Team plans available.

tools.name: Lovable
tools.description: AI app builder that turns ideas into full-stack web apps with a chat interface.
tools.longDescription: Lovable (formerly GPT Engineer) is an AI-powered app builder that creates full-stack web applications from conversational prompts. It generates clean React + TypeScript code with Supabase backend integration. Features include GitHub sync, one-click deployment, real-time preview, and iterative refinement through chat. Designed for entrepreneurs and non-developers who want to ship fast.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited credits. Starter at $20/mo. Pro at $50/mo.
cons: Can be slow for complex apps

tools.name: Gamma
tools.description: AI presentation and document builder — create beautiful slides in seconds.
tools.longDescription: Gamma is an AI-powered tool for creating presentations, documents, and web pages. Just describe your topic and Gamma generates polished, visually appealing slides with proper structure, imagery, and design. Features include one-click restyling, analytics, embedded media, and export to PowerPoint/PDF. No more fighting with slide layouts and formatting.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 400 AI credits. Plus at $10/mo. Pro at $20/mo.
tools.founder: Grant Lee, Jon Noronha, James Fox

tools.name: Beautiful.ai
tools.description: AI presentation software with smart templates that auto-adjust layouts.
tools.longDescription: Beautiful.ai uses AI to automatically design stunning presentations. Smart slide templates adapt as you add content, ensuring everything stays perfectly formatted. Features include DesignerBot for AI-generated slides, brand controls, team collaboration, and presentation analytics. Used by teams at Google, Salesforce, and thousands of companies for professional presentations without design skills.
tools.pricingDetails: Pro at $12/mo. Team at $40/user/mo. Enterprise custom pricing.

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.description: AI video platform for creating talking avatar videos and translations.
tools.longDescription: HeyGen is an AI video creation platform specializing in talking avatar videos. Create professional videos with 300+ customizable AI avatars speaking in 175+ languages. Features include instant video translation with lip-sync, custom avatar creation, interactive avatars for real-time conversations, and API access. Used for marketing, sales, training, and localization.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 3 videos. Creator at $24/mo. Business at $72/mo.

tools.name: Pika
tools.description: AI video generator that creates and edits cinematic videos from text and images.
tools.longDescription: Pika is an AI video generation platform that creates cinematic video clips from text descriptions or images. Known for expressive motion, creative effects, and intuitive editing. Features include Pika Effects for physics-defying transformations, lip sync, and scene extension. Popular among social media creators and storytellers for making eye-catching video content quickly.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited credits. Standard at $8/mo. Pro at $28/mo.

tools.name: Writesonic
tools.description: AI writing platform for articles, blog posts, ads, and SEO content.
tools.longDescription: Writesonic is an AI writing platform that generates high-quality articles, blog posts, ad copy, product descriptions, and landing pages. Features include Chatsonic (AI chatbot with web access), Botsonic (custom chatbot builder), SEO optimization tools, and brand voice customization. Supports 25+ languages and integrates with WordPress, Zapier, and other tools.
tools.pricingDetails: Free trial available. Individual at $16/mo. Team at $13/user/mo.

tools.name: Surfer SEO
tools.description: AI-powered SEO tool for content optimization and search ranking improvement.
tools.longDescription: Surfer SEO is an AI-powered content optimization platform that helps you rank higher in search results. It analyzes top-ranking pages and provides real-time guidelines for content structure, keywords, headings, and word count. Features include AI article writer, content editor with live SEO score, keyword research, SERP analyzer, and internal linking suggestions. Used by content marketers and SEO professionals worldwide.
tools.pricingDetails: Essential at $89/mo. Scale at $129/mo. Enterprise custom pricing.

tools.name: Tome
tools.description: AI-powered storytelling platform for presentations and visual narratives.
tools.longDescription: Tome is an AI-native storytelling and presentation platform. It generates entire presentations from a single prompt, complete with narrative structure, visuals, and layouts. Features include AI page generation, image creation, web embedding, and analytics. Designed for knowledge workers, sales teams, and creators who need to communicate ideas visually without spending hours on slides.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited AI credits. Pro at $16/mo. Enterprise custom pricing.

tools.name: Grok
tools.description: xAI's witty AI chatbot with real-time X/Twitter data access.
tools.longDescription: Grok by xAI is an AI assistant with a bold personality and real-time access to X (Twitter) data. Powered by the Grok-3 model, it excels at reasoning, coding, and current events. Features include image generation with Aurora, DeepSearch for thorough research, and Think mode for step-by-step reasoning. Known for unfiltered, direct responses.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with X account. SuperGrok at $30/mo for higher limits.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.description: Microsoft's AI assistant integrated across Windows, Edge, and Microsoft 365.
tools.longDescription: Microsoft Copilot is an AI assistant deeply integrated into the Microsoft ecosystem. Available in Windows, Edge browser, and Microsoft 365 apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams). Features include document drafting, data analysis in Excel, presentation creation, email summarization, and meeting transcription. Powered by OpenAI models with enterprise security.
tools.pricingDetails: Free basic access. Copilot Pro at $20/mo. Microsoft 365 Copilot at $30/user/mo.

tools.name: Leonardo AI
tools.description: AI image and video generation platform with fine-tuned creative models.
tools.longDescription: Leonardo AI is a creative AI platform for generating images, videos, and 3D textures. Features include Phoenix and Flux models for image generation, motion generation for video, real-time canvas for interactive editing, and the ability to train custom models on your own assets. Popular with game developers, designers, and digital artists for production-quality creative assets.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 150 tokens/day. Apprentice at $12/mo. Artisan at $30/mo.

tools.name: Ideogram
tools.description: AI image generator with best-in-class text rendering in images.
tools.longDescription: Ideogram is an AI image generation tool known for accurately rendering text within images — a challenge for most AI image generators. Produces high-quality art, logos, posters, and typography-heavy designs. Features include Magic Prompt for enhancing descriptions, style presets, and image editing tools. Ideal for designers needing reliable text in generated images.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited generations. Basic at $8/mo. Plus at $20/mo.

tools.name: Flux
tools.description: Open-source AI image model by Black Forest Labs with photorealistic quality.
tools.longDescription: Flux by Black Forest Labs is a state-of-the-art open-source image generation model family. Flux.1 Pro and Dev produce photorealistic images with excellent prompt adherence. Known for natural lighting, human anatomy accuracy, and diverse outputs. Available on platforms like Replicate, fal.ai, and locally via ComfyUI. Created by the original Stable Diffusion team.
tools.pricingDetails: Open-source models free to run. API access via third-party platforms from $0.01/image.
cons: Requires technical setup for local use

tools.name: Adobe Firefly
tools.description: Adobe's AI image generator — commercially safe, integrated into Creative Cloud.
tools.longDescription: Adobe Firefly is a family of creative AI models trained on licensed content, making outputs safe for commercial use. Integrated into Photoshop, Illustrator, and other Adobe apps. Features include text-to-image, generative fill, generative expand, text effects, and vector generation. Ideal for professionals who need commercially licensed AI-generated content within their existing Adobe workflow.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 25 credits/mo. Premium at $10/mo. Included in Creative Cloud plans.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.description: Anthropic's agentic coding CLI — builds features, fixes bugs, handles repos.
tools.longDescription: Claude Code is Anthropic's command-line tool for agentic coding. It reads your entire codebase, makes multi-file edits, runs tests, and handles git operations autonomously. Powered by Claude with extended thinking. Features include background agents, parallel task execution, MCP server integration, and IDE extensions for VS Code and JetBrains. Built for developers who want AI that truly understands their codebase.
tools.pricingDetails: Requires Claude Max ($100/mo) or API usage. Included in Claude Pro with limits.
cons: Can be expensive for large tasks

tools.name: Windsurf
tools.description: AI-powered code editor with Cascade — an agentic coding assistant.
tools.longDescription: Windsurf (formerly Codeium) is an AI-powered IDE with Cascade, a deeply integrated agentic coding assistant. Cascade understands your full codebase context, suggests multi-file edits, runs terminal commands, and handles complex coding tasks autonomously. Features include Flows for collaborative AI coding, inline suggestions, and support for all major languages and frameworks.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Pro at $15/mo. Team at $35/user/mo.

tools.name: Hugging Face
tools.description: The GitHub of machine learning — models, datasets, and AI community hub.
tools.longDescription: Hugging Face is the largest open-source AI community and platform. Host and discover over 500K models, 100K datasets, and 200K demo apps. Features include Transformers library, Inference API, Spaces for hosting ML demos, AutoTrain for no-code model training, and enterprise deployment options. The essential platform for AI researchers, developers, and teams building with open-source models.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for public repos. Pro at $9/mo. Enterprise from $20/user/mo.
tools.founder: Clément Delangue, Julien Chaumond, Thomas Wolf

tools.name: Replicate
tools.description: Run open-source AI models in the cloud with a simple API.
tools.longDescription: Replicate makes it easy to run open-source machine learning models in the cloud via API. Access thousands of models for image generation, language, audio, video, and more — including Flux, LLaMA, Whisper, and SDXL. Features include serverless GPU inference, model fine-tuning, deployments for production, and a simple pay-per-use pricing model. No ML infrastructure needed.
tools.pricingDetails: Pay per prediction. GPU time from $0.000225/sec. Free tier for exploration.

tools.name: Ollama
tools.description: Run large language models locally on your machine — free and private.
tools.longDescription: Ollama lets you run open-source large language models locally on your computer. Supports LLaMA, Mistral, Gemma, Phi, and dozens more models with simple one-line commands. Features include model customization, API compatibility, GPU acceleration, and a growing library of models. Perfect for developers who want private, offline AI without cloud dependencies.
tools.pricingDetails: Completely free and open source. Run on your own hardware.

tools.name: LM Studio
tools.description: Desktop app for running local LLMs with a beautiful chat interface.
tools.longDescription: LM Studio is a desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running local large language models. Features a polished chat interface, model search from Hugging Face, quantization support for running on consumer hardware, OpenAI-compatible local server, and multi-model conversations. Supports GGUF models with GPU acceleration on Mac, Windows, and Linux.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for personal use. Business licensing available.

tools.name: OpenRouter
tools.description: Unified API for accessing all major AI models — one key, every model.
tools.longDescription: OpenRouter provides a single API to access models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, and dozens more providers. Features include automatic fallback between providers, usage-based pricing with no subscriptions, model comparison, and OAuth for app developers. The simplest way to access the full landscape of AI models without managing multiple API keys.
tools.pricingDetails: Pay-per-token pricing. Some free models available. No subscription required.
pros: Access many models via one API

tools.name: Zapier AI
tools.description: AI-powered automation — connect apps and build workflows with natural language.
tools.longDescription: Zapier's AI features let you build automations using natural language. Describe what you want to automate and Zapier creates the workflow. Features include AI-powered Zaps, Chatbots for customer interactions, Canvas for visual workflow building, and Tables for data management. Connects 7,000+ apps with AI-enhanced automation for businesses of any size.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 100 tasks/mo. Starter at $20/mo. Professional at $49/mo.
tools.founder: Wade Foster, Bryan Helmig, Mike Knoop
integrations: 6000+ apps including Gmail, Slack, Notion, Salesforce

tools.name: Make
tools.description: Visual automation platform with AI capabilities for complex workflows.
tools.longDescription: Make (formerly Integromat) is a visual workflow automation platform with powerful AI integration capabilities. Build complex multi-step automations with a drag-and-drop interface. Features include AI modules for text generation, image processing, and data extraction. Connects to 1,800+ apps and services. More flexible than Zapier for complex logic with branching, loops, and error handling.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 1,000 ops/mo. Core at $9/mo. Pro at $16/mo.

tools.name: Otter.ai
tools.description: AI meeting assistant — real-time transcription, summaries, and action items.
tools.longDescription: Otter.ai is an AI-powered meeting assistant that provides real-time transcription, automated summaries, and action item extraction. It joins your Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams calls automatically. Features include OtterPilot for live transcription, speaker identification, keyword highlights, and searchable meeting archives. Essential for teams that want to focus on meetings instead of taking notes.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with 300 min/mo. Pro at $17/mo. Business at $30/user/mo.

tools.name: Fireflies.ai
tools.description: AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and analyzes meetings automatically.
tools.longDescription: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes your meetings. It integrates with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, and 50+ other apps. Features include smart search across all meetings, topic tracking, sentiment analysis, conversation intelligence, and automated CRM logging. Helps teams capture every decision and action item without manual effort.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited credits. Pro at $18/mo. Business at $29/user/mo.

tools.name: Murf AI
tools.description: AI voice generator with 200+ natural-sounding voices for professional audio.
tools.longDescription: Murf AI is a text-to-speech platform with over 200 natural-sounding AI voices in 20+ languages. Used for voiceovers, e-learning, podcasts, and video narration. Features include voice cloning, voice changer, AI dubbing, and a studio editor for adding media. Produces studio-quality voiceovers without recording equipment or voice talent.
tools.pricingDetails: Free trial available. Creator at $26/mo. Business at $59/mo.
tools.founder: Divyanshu Pandey, Sneha Roy, Ankur Edkie

tools.name: Speechify
tools.description: AI text-to-speech reader that turns any text into natural audio.
tools.longDescription: Speechify converts any text into natural-sounding speech. Read articles, PDFs, emails, and documents aloud with AI voices. Features include browser extension, mobile app, OCR for scanning physical text, speed control up to 4.5x, and celebrity voice options. Used by millions for accessibility, learning, and productivity — listen to anything while multitasking.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited voices. Premium at $14/mo with all features.

tools.name: Photopea
tools.description: Free online photo editor with AI features — a Photoshop alternative in your browser.
tools.longDescription: Photopea is a free, browser-based photo editor that supports PSD, AI, XD, Sketch, and other file formats. Features AI-powered tools including generative fill, background removal, and object removal. Full layer support, masks, filters, and vector tools make it a powerful Photoshop alternative that runs entirely in your browser with no installation required.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with ads. Premium at $5/mo removes ads and adds extra features.
cons: Can be slow with large files

tools.name: Remove.bg
tools.description: AI background removal — remove image backgrounds in seconds automatically.
tools.longDescription: Remove.bg uses AI to automatically remove backgrounds from images in seconds. Works with people, products, animals, cars, and more. Features include batch processing, API integration, Photoshop plugin, and high-resolution downloads. Used by e-commerce, designers, and marketers for product photos, profile pictures, and creative compositions.
tools.pricingDetails: Free preview quality. Credits from $0.20/image. Subscription from $9/mo.

tools.name: Luma AI
tools.description: AI video generation with Dream Machine — create cinematic videos from text.
tools.longDescription: Luma AI's Dream Machine generates high-quality, realistic videos from text prompts and images. Known for physical realism, smooth motion, and cinematic quality. Features include camera control, character consistency, keyframe animation, and image-to-video generation. Used by filmmakers, advertisers, and content creators for professional-grade AI video production.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limited generations. Standard at $10/mo. Pro at $30/mo.

tools.name: InVideo AI
tools.description: AI video creator — turn text prompts into ready-to-publish videos.
tools.longDescription: InVideo AI transforms text prompts into complete, edited videos with stock footage, voiceover, subtitles, and music. Just describe your video idea and the AI handles scripting, scene selection, editing, and production. Features include brand presets, multilingual support, and iterative editing through chat. Perfect for YouTube creators, marketers, and businesses who need video content fast.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with watermark. Plus at $25/mo. Max at $50/mo.
tools.founder: Sanket Shah, Harsh Vakharia, Pankit Chheda

tools.name: PhotoRoom
tools.description: AI photo editor for product photography — remove backgrounds, create studio shots.
tools.longDescription: PhotoRoom is an AI-powered photo editing tool specialized for product photography and e-commerce. Instantly remove backgrounds, generate studio-quality product photos, and create consistent listings. Features include batch editing, AI backgrounds, shadow generation, and resize for any platform. Used by millions of sellers on Etsy, Amazon, eBay, and Shopify.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with watermark. Pro at $13/mo. Business pricing available.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.description: AI-powered academic search engine — find and understand research papers.

Essential for researchers, students, and anyone who wants evidence-backed answers.

tools.longDescription: Together AI provides infrastructure for running open-source AI models at scale. Features include serverless inference, fine-tuning, custom model deployment, and a GPU cluster marketplace. Supports hundreds of models including Llama, Mixtral, FLUX, and Stable Diffusion.
tools.pricingDetails: Free $5 credit. Pay-per-use inference from $0.20/M tokens.

tools.name: Chatbase
tools.description: Build custom AI chatbots for your website.
tools.longDescription: Chatbase lets you create custom AI chatbots trained on your data. Upload documents, connect websites, and build chatbots that answer questions about your business for customer support and lead generation.
tools.pricingDetails: Free basic. Hobby at $19/mo. Standard at $99/mo.

tools.name: Voiceflow
tools.description: Build and deploy AI agents for support.
tools.longDescription: Voiceflow provides a collaborative platform for designing, building, and deploying AI chat and voice agents. Create sophisticated conversational experiences for customer support and engagement.

tools.name: Flair AI
tools.description: AI product photography — studio-quality shots with AI backgrounds.
tools.longDescription: Flair AI generates professional product photography with AI backgrounds. Upload a product and create marketing photos instantly.

tools.name: Cleanup.pictures
tools.longDescription: Cleanup.pictures removes unwanted objects, people, text, and defects from photos using AI. Simply brush over what you want to remove and the AI intelligently fills in the background.

tools.name: HeadshotPro
tools.description: AI professional headshot generator from selfies.
tools.longDescription: HeadshotPro creates studio-quality professional headshots from selfies using AI. Multiple outfit and background options.

tools.name: Picsart
tools.description: AI photo and video editing platform with creative tools.
tools.longDescription: Picsart offers AI image generation, background removal, smart selection, and creative filters. 150M+ monthly active creators.

tools.name: Adobe Express
tools.description: AI content creation for social media, flyers, and videos.
tools.longDescription: Adobe Express creates social media posts, flyers, logos, and videos with Firefly AI. Features brand kit and Creative Cloud integration.

tools.name: Simplified
tools.longDescription: Simplified combines AI writing, graphic design, video editing, and social media management in one platform. Features AI one-click generation for all content types.

tools.name: Snyk AI
tools.description: AI-powered security scanning for code, dependencies, containers, and IaC.
tools.longDescription: Snyk uses AI to find and fix security vulnerabilities across your code, open-source dependencies, container images, and infrastructure as code. DeepCode AI provides intelligent code analysis with auto-fix suggestions that understand your codebase context.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for individuals. Team at $25/dev/mo. Enterprise custom.

tools.name: LangChain
tools.description: Open-source framework for building LLM-powered applications.
tools.longDescription: LangChain is the leading framework for LLM apps with chains, agents, RAG, and LangSmith monitoring. Supports Python and JavaScript.

tools.name: Pinecone
tools.longDescription: Pinecone is a fully managed vector database designed for AI applications. It provides fast, scalable vector search with simple APIs, making it easy to build recommendation, search, and RAG systems.

tools.name: ClickUp
tools.longDescription: ClickUp combines tasks, docs, goals, whiteboards, and chat in one platform. Features AI assistant, custom views, automations, and integrations for replacing multiple tools.

tools.name: Linear AI
tools.description: AI-powered project management with auto-triage, summaries, and smart workflows.
tools.longDescription: Linear integrates AI throughout its project management experience. Features include automatic issue triage, AI-generated project updates, smart duplicate detection, natural language issue creation, and cycle summaries. Makes engineering project management faster and more organized.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for small teams. Plus at $8/user/mo. Enterprise custom.

tools.name: ManyChat
tools.description: AI chatbot automation for Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger.
tools.longDescription: ManyChat automates conversations on Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger. Visual flow builder, AI responses, and comment automation for 1M+ businesses.

tools.name: Mailchimp AI
tools.longDescription: Mailchimp's AI features help with email content generation, send time optimization, audience segmentation, and campaign performance predictions. AI makes email marketing smarter and more effective.
tools.pricingDetails: Free up to 500 contacts. Standard at $13.99/mo.

tools.name: HubSpot AI
tools.description: AI-powered marketing, sales, and CRM platform.
tools.longDescription: HubSpot's AI features span marketing, sales, and customer service. Generate content, optimize campaigns, score leads, and automate workflows with AI integrated throughout the CRM platform.

tools.name: Fathom
tools.description: Free AI meeting assistant and note-taker.
tools.longDescription: Fathom is a free AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes video calls. It generates meeting highlights, action items, and syncs notes to your CRM automatically.
cons: Paid plans required for full functionality

tools.name: Meta Llama 3
tools.description: Meta's most capable open-source LLM family for chat and coding.
tools.longDescription: Meta's Llama 3 is the latest generation of open-source large language models. Available in 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter sizes, it excels at chat, coding, reasoning, and multilingual tasks. Can be self-hosted or accessed through various cloud providers.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. Cloud hosting costs vary by provider.

tools.name: Mistral Agents
tools.description: Build and deploy AI agents with Mistral's latest models and tools.
tools.longDescription: Mistral's agent platform lets developers build AI agents with access to web search, code execution, image generation, and custom tools. Agents can be deployed via API or embedded in applications, powered by Mistral's latest language models.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier on Le Chat. API pricing from $0.25/M tokens.

tools.name: Anthropic Claude API
tools.description: API access to Claude models for building AI-powered applications.
tools.longDescription: The Anthropic API provides programmatic access to Claude models for building AI applications. Features include streaming, tool use, vision, extended thinking, batch processing, and prompt caching. Supports Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku model variants.
tools.pricingDetails: Pay-per-use. Sonnet from $3/M input. Opus from $15/M input.

tools.name: OpenAI API
tools.description: API for GPT-4, DALL-E, Whisper, and other OpenAI models.
tools.longDescription: The OpenAI API provides access to GPT-4, GPT-4o, DALL-E 3, Whisper, and TTS models. Features include function calling, structured outputs, vision, file search, code interpreter, and the Assistants API for building stateful AI agents.
tools.pricingDetails: Pay-per-use. GPT-4o from $2.50/M input. GPT-4o mini from $0.15/M input.

tools.name: Miro
tools.longDescription: Miro is a visual collaboration platform for teams. Features include infinite canvas, templates, diagramming, sticky notes, and real-time collaboration across distributed teams.
cons: Can be laggy with large boards

tools.name: Clipchamp
tools.description: Microsoft free AI video editor with captions and text-to-speech.
tools.longDescription: Clipchamp is Microsoft's free video editor with auto-captions, text-to-speech, screen recording, and stock media. Included with Windows 11.

tools.name: Magical
tools.description: AI that automates typing, messaging, and data entry.
tools.longDescription: Magical automates repetitive typing and data entry. AI message drafts, text expansion, and auto-fill across web apps as a Chrome extension.
cons: Paid plans required for full functionality

tools.name: Lex
tools.longDescription: Lex is a minimalist writing editor with built-in AI assistance. Features include AI drafting, title suggestions, and a clean distraction-free interface designed for deep thinking and writing.

tools.name: Jenni AI Research
tools.description: AI research writing assistant with citations.
tools.longDescription: Jenni AI helps researchers and students write papers with AI assistance. Features include autocomplete, citation generation from real papers, outline creation, and paraphrasing tools.

tools.name: Unbounce
tools.description: AI landing page builder with smart traffic optimization.
tools.longDescription: Unbounce creates high-converting landing pages with Smart Traffic auto-routing visitors to best variants. Drag-and-drop builder.

tools.name: Browse AI
tools.longDescription: Browse AI trains robots to extract and monitor data from websites without code. It handles pagination, login-required sites, and dynamic content with AI-powered element detection.
cons: Paid plans required for full functionality

tools.name: Mixpanel
tools.description: Product analytics with AI-powered insights and user behavior.
tools.longDescription: Mixpanel offers product analytics with Spark AI for natural language queries. Event tracking, funnels, and retention analysis.

tools.name: Adobe Podcast
tools.description: AI audio enhancement — studio-quality sound from any mic.
tools.longDescription: Adobe Podcast enhances audio to studio quality. Removes noise, echo, and reverb. Features transcript-based editing. Free and browser-based.

tools.name: Coda AI
tools.description: AI assistant for docs, tables, and workflows.
tools.longDescription: Coda AI helps you write, analyze data, create formulas, and automate workflows within Coda documents. It understands your doc context to provide relevant suggestions and automate repetitive tasks.
tools.pricingDetails: Free basic. Pro at $10/user/mo. AI add-on available.
cons: Paid plans required for full functionality

tools.name: Vercel AI SDK
tools.description: TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered apps with React and Next.js.
tools.longDescription: The Vercel AI SDK is a TypeScript toolkit for building AI applications. It provides React hooks for streaming chat UIs, server-side AI functions, tool calling, structured output, and multi-model support. The standard library for AI in the JavaScript ecosystem.

tools.name: Crisp
tools.longDescription: Crisp provides live chat, chatbot, CRM, and shared inbox for teams. Features include video chat, co-browsing, and multichannel messaging across your website, email, and social media.

tools.name: Vidyo.ai
tools.description: AI video repurposing — short clips from long videos.
tools.longDescription: Vidyo.ai auto-creates short-form clips from long videos. AI identifies engaging moments for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts with captions.

tools.name: Notion Database
tools.description: AI-enhanced relational databases with smart properties and automations.
tools.longDescription: Notion's database feature now includes AI-powered properties for auto-summarization, auto-filling, and data extraction. Create linked relational databases for any workflow.
cons: Can be slow with large databases

tools.name: Niji Journey v6
tools.longDescription: Niji Journey (by Midjourney) specializes in anime and illustration-style AI art generation. Version 6 offers improved character consistency, better hands, and more expressive art styles.

tools.name: Photoshop AI
tools.description: Adobe Photoshop with generative fill, expand, and AI-powered editing.
tools.longDescription: Photoshop's AI features include Generative Fill for adding or removing objects, Generative Expand for extending images, and AI-powered selection tools. Built on Adobe Firefly.
tools.pricingDetails: $23/mo as part of Creative Cloud Photography plan.

tools.name: Sana
tools.longDescription: Sana provides AI-powered learning and knowledge management for enterprises. Features include personalized learning paths, AI search across company knowledge, and automated content creation.

tools.name: Grain
tools.longDescription: Grain records meetings and uses AI to create shareable highlights. Automatically transcribes, summarizes, and creates clips from important moments in your meetings.

tools.name: Text Blaze
tools.longDescription: Text Blaze creates dynamic text snippets and templates that expand with keyboard shortcuts. AI features help generate content, fill forms, and automate repetitive text entry across apps.

tools.name: Loom AI
tools.description: AI-powered video messaging with auto-summaries and chapters.
tools.longDescription: Loom's AI features auto-generate video titles, summaries, chapters, and tasks. Remove filler words and silences automatically. Perfect for async communication.

tools.name: Unriddle
tools.description: AI research tool — read, understand, and navigate complex documents.
tools.longDescription: Unriddle helps you understand complex documents with AI. Ask questions, get explanations, and navigate research papers, legal docs, and technical content faster.

tools.name: Spline
tools.longDescription: Spline lets you create 3D designs and experiences directly in the browser. Features real-time collaboration, animations, interactions, and easy embedding in websites.

tools.name: Relume
tools.description: AI website builder for designers — generates sitemaps and wireframes.
tools.longDescription: Relume uses AI to generate complete website sitemaps and wireframes from a text description. Export directly to Figma or Webflow for design customization.

tools.name: Lexica
tools.description: AI image search engine and generator — explore millions of AI images.
tools.longDescription: Lexica is a search engine for AI-generated images. Browse millions of images with their prompts for inspiration, and generate your own with Lexica Aperture model.
tools.pricingDetails: Free browsing. Starter at $8/mo for generation.

tools.name: Playground
tools.description: AI image generation platform with a free creative canvas.
tools.longDescription: Playground offers AI image generation with a generous free tier. Features multiple models, image editing, mixed image generation, and a canvas for compositing.

tools.name: LiveKit
tools.description: Open-source real-time AI infrastructure for voice and video agents.
tools.longDescription: LiveKit provides open-source infrastructure for building real-time AI voice and video agents. Features WebRTC transport, agent framework, and telephony integration.

tools.name: Postbot
tools.description: AI assistant in Postman for API testing and documentation.
tools.longDescription: Postbot is Postman's AI assistant that generates API tests, writes documentation, debugs requests, and helps with API design. Integrated into the Postman API platform.

tools.name: Raycast Pro AI
tools.description: AI built into macOS launcher for instant access to AI across any app.
tools.longDescription: Raycast Pro adds powerful AI capabilities to the popular macOS launcher. Access AI chat, translations, code generation, and custom AI commands from anywhere on your Mac with a keyboard shortcut. Supports multiple AI models including GPT-4 and Claude.
tools.pricingDetails: Free launcher. Pro at $8/mo for AI features.

tools.name: Arc Max AI
tools.description: AI features built into Arc Browser including page summaries and tab renaming.
tools.longDescription: Arc Max brings AI features directly into the Arc browser experience. Features include 5-second page previews, automatic tab renaming, Ask on Page for in-context Q&A, ChatGPT integration in the command bar, and tidy tab organization. All features work seamlessly within browsing.

tools.name: Warp Terminal
tools.description: AI-powered terminal with natural language commands and blocks.
tools.longDescription: Warp is a modern terminal with AI built in. Ask questions in natural language, get command suggestions, and use block-based output for better organization. Features Warp AI for terminal assistance.

tools.name: Granola
tools.description: AI notepad for meetings that enhances your notes with transcript context.
tools.longDescription: Granola is an AI meeting notepad that works differently from traditional transcription tools. You take brief notes during meetings, and Granola enhances them using the meeting transcript to create detailed, structured notes in your own style and voice.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 25 meetings. Pro at $18/mo.

tools.name: ChatGOT
tools.description: Chat with multiple AI models simultaneously.
tools.longDescription: ChatGOT lets you send the same prompt to multiple AI models at once and compare responses side by side. Access GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and other models from one unified interface.

tools.name: CopyMonkey
tools.description: AI Amazon listing optimization — generate and optimize product listings.
tools.longDescription: CopyMonkey generates and optimizes Amazon product listings using AI. Analyzes competitor listings and keywords to create high-ranking product titles, bullets, and descriptions.

tools.name: GetResponse AI
tools.description: AI email marketing and automation with website builder.
tools.longDescription: GetResponse integrates AI across its marketing platform. Features AI email generator, subject line optimizer, AI website builder, and marketing automation.

tools.name: Merlin AI
tools.description: AI browser extension for summarizing, writing, and chatting on any website.
tools.longDescription: Merlin is a browser extension that brings AI assistance to every website. Summarize articles, write emails, chat with documents, and generate content without switching tabs.

tools.name: Glass AI
tools.description: AI clinical decision support for medical professionals.
tools.longDescription: Glass AI helps physicians generate differential diagnoses and clinical plans from patient presentations. Designed specifically for healthcare professionals.

tools.name: Pitch
tools.longDescription: Pitch combines beautiful templates, real-time collaboration, and smart workflows for modern teams. Create on-brand presentations quickly with AI-assisted content creation.

tools.name: DeepSeek R1
tools.description: Open-source reasoning model with chain-of-thought capabilities.
tools.longDescription: DeepSeek R1 is a powerful open-source reasoning model that excels at complex problem-solving through explicit chain-of-thought reasoning. It rivals top proprietary models on math, coding, and logic benchmarks while being freely available for commercial use.
tools.pricingDetails: Free to use. API pricing at $0.55/M input tokens.

tools.name: Qwen Chat
tools.description: Alibaba's AI assistant with multilingual support.
tools.longDescription: Qwen Chat is Alibaba Cloud's AI assistant powered by the Qwen series of large language models. It supports multiple languages with particular strength in Chinese and English. Features include text generation, coding, and analysis.
tools.pricingDetails: Free to use. Enterprise API available.

tools.name: Coze
tools.description: Build and deploy custom AI chatbots with no code.
tools.longDescription: Coze by ByteDance is a no-code platform for building AI chatbots and agents. Create custom bots with plugins, workflows, and knowledge bases. Deploy across multiple platforms including Discord, Telegram, and websites.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available. Pro plans for higher usage.

tools.name: HuggingChat
tools.description: Open-source AI chat powered by community models.
tools.longDescription: HuggingChat is Hugging Face's free and open-source chat interface. It lets you chat with various open-source models including Llama, Mistral, and others. Supports web search, file uploads, and custom assistants.
tools.pricingDetails: Completely free. Powered by open-source models.

tools.name: AI21 Jamba
tools.description: Hybrid AI model for efficient long-context tasks.
tools.longDescription: AI21's Jamba is a hybrid SSM-Transformer model designed for efficient processing of long contexts. It offers strong performance on enterprise tasks like summarization, Q&A, and content generation with lower compute costs.
tools.pricingDetails: Free playground. API pricing starts at usage-based rates.

tools.name: Chai AI
tools.description: Chat with AI personalities and create your own.
tools.longDescription: Chai AI is a platform for conversational AI where users can chat with various AI personalities or create their own characters. It features a social feed of community-created bots and supports creative roleplay scenarios.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with limits. Premium at $13.99/mo for unlimited.

tools.name: Replika
tools.description: AI companion for emotional support and conversation.
tools.longDescription: Replika is a personal AI companion designed for emotional support and meaningful conversations. It learns your communication style over time and can serve as a friend, mentor, or creative partner. Features include video calls and AR experiences.
tools.pricingDetails: Free basic chat. Pro at $19.99/mo for full features.

tools.name: Jasper Chat
tools.description: AI chat assistant built for marketing teams.
tools.longDescription: Jasper Chat is an AI assistant specifically designed for marketing teams. It understands marketing context and can help with content creation, campaign planning, and brand voice consistency. Integrates with Jasper's broader AI platform.

tools.name: Kuki AI
tools.longDescription: Kuki (formerly Mitsuku) is an award-winning chatbot that has won the Loebner Prize multiple times. It offers engaging conversation with personality and humor. Available for integration into websites and apps.
tools.pricingDetails: Free to chat. Enterprise integration pricing on request.

tools.name: Forefront AI
tools.description: Access multiple AI models in one chat interface.
tools.longDescription: Forefront AI provides a unified interface to chat with multiple AI models including GPT-4, Claude, and open-source alternatives. Features include internet browsing, file uploads, and custom personas for different use cases.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with limits. Pro at $29/mo.

tools.name: Perplexity Labs
tools.description: Experimental AI models for advanced reasoning.
tools.longDescription: Perplexity Labs offers access to experimental and cutting-edge AI models for testing and research. Try the latest open-source models and Perplexity's own experimental releases with real-time web search capabilities.
tools.pricingDetails: Free to use during experimental phase.

tools.name: ChatGLM
tools.description: Bilingual AI assistant by Zhipu AI.
tools.longDescription: ChatGLM is a bilingual (Chinese-English) AI assistant developed by Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University. It offers strong performance on both languages with capabilities in coding, math, and creative writing.
tools.pricingDetails: Free to use. API available for developers.

tools.name: Baichuan AI
tools.description: Chinese AI assistant with strong language abilities.
tools.longDescription: Baichuan AI offers a powerful Chinese-first AI assistant with strong capabilities in content generation, knowledge Q&A, and creative writing. Built on Baichuan's series of large language models.
tools.pricingDetails: Free to use. Enterprise solutions available.

tools.name: Coral by Cohere
tools.longDescription: Coral is Cohere's enterprise AI assistant that connects to your company's data sources. It provides accurate, grounded answers using retrieval-augmented generation with citations from your documents.

tools.name: Groq Cloud
tools.description: Ultra-fast LLM inference with custom hardware delivering 10x speed.
tools.longDescription: Groq provides ultra-fast LLM inference using custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware. It delivers responses 10x faster than GPU-based alternatives, making it ideal for latency-sensitive applications. Supports Llama, Mixtral, and other open-source models.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier. Developer at $0.05-0.08 per 1M tokens.

tools.name: Venice AI
tools.description: Private AI chat with no data collection.
tools.longDescription: Venice AI is a privacy-focused AI chat platform that does not store conversations or collect user data. It offers uncensored access to open-source models with a focus on user privacy and freedom.

tools.name: Nat.dev
tools.description: Compare AI models side by side in real time.
tools.longDescription: Nat.dev lets you test and compare multiple AI models simultaneously. Send the same prompt to different models and see responses side by side. Great for evaluating model quality and finding the best fit for your needs.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier. Premium for faster and more models.

tools.name: Craiyon
tools.description: Free AI image generator from text prompts.
tools.longDescription: Craiyon (formerly DALL-E Mini) is a free AI image generator that creates images from text descriptions. While not as high-quality as premium alternatives, it offers unlimited free generations and a fun creative experience.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with ads. Supporter at $6/mo. Professional at $24/mo.

tools.name: BlueWillow
tools.description: Free AI art generator via Discord.
tools.longDescription: BlueWillow is a free AI image generator accessible through Discord. It uses multiple AI models to create images from text prompts. Great for beginners exploring AI art without upfront costs.

tools.name: Pixlr AI
tools.description: AI-powered online photo editor and generator.
tools.longDescription: Pixlr AI combines a full-featured online photo editor with AI capabilities. Generate images from text, remove backgrounds, enhance photos, and apply AI-powered effects all in your browser.

tools.name: Fotor AI
tools.description: AI image generator and photo enhancement suite.
tools.longDescription: Fotor AI offers a comprehensive suite of AI-powered image tools including text-to-image generation, photo enhancement, background removal, and AI avatars. Easy to use with no design experience needed.

tools.name: PicWish

tools.name: StarryAI

tools.name: WOMBO Dream

tools.name: ImgCreator.ai

tools.name: getimg.ai

tools.name: Tensor.art

tools.description: AI art generator with creative tools and workflows.

tools.name: Mage.space

tools.name: Dzine AI

tools.name: SeaArt AI
tools.description: AI art creation platform with model marketplace.

tools.name: FlexClip

tools.name: Animoto
