tools.longDescription: Gencraft is a mobile-focused AI image generator that creates stylized art from text prompts. Popular for creating avatars, artistic portraits, and fantasy-style images.

tools.name: Perplexity Pages
tools.description: AI-powered article generator with real-time web research.
tools.longDescription: Perplexity Pages transforms research queries into well-structured, publishable articles with citations. Combines AI writing with real-time web search for accurate, source-backed content.

tools.name: AI2sql
tools.description: AI tool that converts natural language to SQL queries.
tools.longDescription: AI2sql helps non-technical users and developers generate SQL queries from plain English descriptions. Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and other databases.

tools.name: Mapify
tools.description: AI-powered mind mapping from any content source.
tools.longDescription: Mapify transforms any content — URLs, documents, text, or YouTube videos — into visual mind maps using AI. Great for studying, brainstorming, and organizing complex information.

tools.name: DoNotPay
tools.description: AI legal assistant for consumer rights and dispute resolution.
tools.longDescription: DoNotPay uses AI to help with legal tasks like fighting parking tickets, canceling subscriptions, getting refunds, and drafting legal documents. The world's first robot lawyer.

tools.name: Tango
tools.description: AI-powered workflow documentation with automatic screenshots.
tools.longDescription: Tango automatically captures your workflow and creates step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots. Share guides as links, embed in docs, or export to PDF.

tools.name: Mem0
tools.description: Memory layer for AI applications and agents.
tools.longDescription: Mem0 provides a smart memory layer for AI applications. It enables personalized AI experiences by remembering user preferences, past interactions, and context across sessions.

tools.name: Brevo AI
tools.description: AI-powered email marketing and CRM platform.
tools.longDescription: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) uses AI for email marketing optimization, send-time prediction, subject line generation, and customer segmentation. All-in-one marketing platform with CRM.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 300 emails/day. Starter at $25/mo.

tools.name: Chatfuel
tools.description: AI chatbot builder for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook.
tools.longDescription: Chatfuel helps businesses build AI chatbots for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook Messenger. No-code builder with templates, lead generation, and e-commerce integrations.

tools.name: Mermaid AI
tools.description: AI-powered diagram generation using Mermaid.js syntax.
tools.longDescription: Mermaid AI generates flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, and more from text descriptions. Uses Mermaid.js syntax that integrates with GitHub, Notion, and other platforms.

tools.name: Dola AI
tools.description: AI calendar assistant accessible via messaging apps.
tools.longDescription: Dola is an AI calendar assistant that works through iMessage, WhatsApp, and other messaging apps. Send natural language messages to schedule events, set reminders, and manage your calendar.

tools.name: Hume EVI
tools.description: Emotionally intelligent voice AI that understands tone and expression.
tools.longDescription: Hume's Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) is a conversational AI that understands emotional nuances in speech. It detects sentiment, adjusts tone, and responds empathetically. Used for customer service, therapy support, and creating more natural AI interactions.
tools.pricingDetails: Free developer tier. Enterprise pricing on request.

tools.name: Grok Image Generator
tools.description: xAI's image generation with minimal content restrictions.
tools.longDescription: Grok's image generation, powered by Aurora, creates high-quality images with fewer content restrictions than competitors. Available through the Grok chatbot on X (Twitter), it handles photorealistic and artistic styles with impressive prompt adherence.
tools.pricingDetails: Free with X Premium. SuperGrok at $30/mo for higher limits.

tools.name: Google Imagen 3
tools.description: Google's highest quality image generation model with photorealistic output.
tools.longDescription: Imagen 3 is Google DeepMind's most advanced image generation model. It produces photorealistic images with exceptional detail, accurate text rendering, and strong prompt adherence. Available through Google AI Studio and Vertex AI with built-in safety features.
tools.pricingDetails: Free in Gemini. API pricing through Vertex AI.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.description: Node-based UI for advanced Stable Diffusion and FLUX workflows.
tools.longDescription: ComfyUI is a powerful, modular node-based interface for AI image generation. It supports Stable Diffusion, FLUX, and other models with a visual workflow editor. Users create complex generation pipelines by connecting nodes, enabling advanced techniques like ControlNet, IP-Adapter, and custom LoRAs.

tools.name: Stable Diffusion WebUI
tools.description: Most popular open-source UI for Stable Diffusion with extensive features.
tools.longDescription: AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion WebUI is the most widely used interface for running Stable Diffusion locally. It offers txt2img, img2img, inpainting, outpainting, and hundreds of extensions. Supports ControlNet, LoRAs, and all SD model variants.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. Requires own GPU.
cons: Can be complex to set up

tools.name: Fooocus
tools.description: Simplified Stable Diffusion UI inspired by Midjourney's ease of use.
tools.longDescription: Fooocus simplifies the Stable Diffusion experience by removing complex parameters and providing Midjourney-like simplicity. It automatically handles model selection, sampling, and other technical details while still producing high-quality results with SDXL and newer models.

tools.name: NovelAI
tools.description: AI storytelling platform for fiction writing with custom trained models.
tools.longDescription: NovelAI is an AI-powered storytelling platform built specifically for creative fiction writing. It uses custom-trained models that excel at narrative, dialogue, and world-building. Features include memory system, lorebook for world details, and text adventure mode.

tools.name: ShortlyAI
tools.description: Minimalist AI writing tool for distraction-free long-form content.
tools.longDescription: ShortlyAI offers a clean, minimalist writing experience powered by AI. Its simple interface lets writers focus on their content while the AI assists with expansion, continuation, and rewriting. No complex menus or options — just write and let AI help.

tools.name: Smodin
tools.description: Multilingual AI writing platform with rewriter, plagiarism checker, and grader.
tools.longDescription: Smodin offers a comprehensive suite of AI writing tools in 100+ languages. Features include an AI writer, rewriter, plagiarism checker, citation generator, and automated grading. Popular with students and educators worldwide for its multilingual capabilities.

tools.name: Gemini Code Assist
tools.description: Google's AI coding assistant powered by Gemini for IDEs and Cloud.
tools.longDescription: Gemini Code Assist brings Google's Gemini models to your IDE with code completion, generation, and explanation. Integrated with Google Cloud, it offers code transformation, debugging assistance, and full codebase understanding with a massive 1M token context window.

tools.name: Augment Code
tools.description: AI coding assistant built for large enterprise codebases.
tools.longDescription: Augment Code is designed for enterprise development teams working with large, complex codebases. It indexes your entire repository for deep understanding, offers context-aware completions, and provides explanations that account for your team's coding patterns and conventions.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for individual developers. Team plans from $30/user/mo.

tools.name: Poolside
tools.description: AI coding assistant trained from scratch specifically for software engineering.
tools.longDescription: Poolside is building AI models trained from scratch specifically for software engineering tasks. Unlike models adapted from general-purpose LLMs, Poolside's models are designed to deeply understand code structure, debugging, and software architecture from the ground up.

tools.name: Google Veo
tools.description: Google DeepMind's video generation model with cinematic understanding.
tools.longDescription: Veo is Google DeepMind's video generation model that creates high-quality 1080p videos from text or image prompts. It understands cinematic concepts like time-lapse, aerial shots, and various visual styles. Available through Google AI Studio and integrated into various Google products.
tools.pricingDetails: Free in select Google products. API pricing through Vertex AI.

tools.name: Fish Audio
tools.description: Open-source text-to-speech and voice cloning with natural results.
tools.longDescription: Fish Audio provides high-quality text-to-speech and voice cloning capabilities. Its open-source models produce natural-sounding speech in multiple languages. Features include voice cloning from short samples, emotional control, and a growing voice library.

tools.name: Cartesia Sonic
tools.description: Ultra-fast, low-latency voice AI for real-time applications.
tools.longDescription: Cartesia's Sonic model delivers ultra-low-latency text-to-speech ideal for real-time conversational AI. With sub-100ms latency, natural prosody, and voice cloning, it's designed for voice agents, phone systems, and interactive applications where speed is critical.
tools.pricingDetails: Free developer tier. Growth from $25/mo. Enterprise custom.

tools.name: Sesame AI
tools.description: Emotionally expressive voice AI with remarkably human-like speech.
tools.longDescription: Sesame AI creates remarkably human-like speech with emotional depth and natural conversation flow. Their voice model captures subtle emotional nuances, making AI voices that sound genuinely engaged and expressive. Currently available as a research demo.
tools.pricingDetails: Free research demo. Commercial pricing TBD.

tools.name: Apple Intelligence
tools.description: Apple's integrated AI across iPhone, iPad, and Mac for writing, images, and Siri.
tools.longDescription: Apple Intelligence is Apple's personal AI system integrated across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. Features include Writing Tools for proofreading and rewriting, Image Playground for creation, Genmoji, enhanced Siri with on-screen awareness, and priority notifications. Processes most requests on-device for privacy.

tools.name: Google AI Overviews
tools.description: Google Search AI that provides synthesized answers above search results.
tools.longDescription: Google AI Overviews provides AI-generated summaries directly in Google Search results. It synthesizes information from multiple sources to answer queries with context, links, and follow-up suggestions. Available in Google Search across web and mobile.

tools.name: CopilotKit
tools.description: Open-source framework for building in-app AI copilots and assistants.
tools.longDescription: CopilotKit is an open-source framework that lets developers add AI copilot features to any React application. Features include AI-powered textareas, chatbots, and agentic actions that interact with your app's state. Build custom copilots with just a few lines of code.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. Cloud hosting available.

tools.name: OpenEvidence
tools.description: AI-powered medical research assistant grounded in clinical evidence.
tools.longDescription: OpenEvidence is an AI assistant for healthcare professionals that provides answers grounded in clinical evidence, guidelines, and medical literature. It cites specific studies and guidelines, making it a trusted tool for clinical decision support.

tools.name: Builder.io Visual Copilot
tools.description: AI that converts Figma designs to clean, production-ready code.
tools.longDescription: Builder.io's Visual Copilot converts Figma designs into clean, responsive code using AI. It supports React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, and more. The AI understands design intent, generates semantic HTML, and respects component libraries and design systems.

tools.name: Motiff
tools.description: AI-powered UI design tool with intelligent layout and design generation.
tools.longDescription: Motiff is an AI-native UI design tool that combines traditional design capabilities with AI assistance. Features include AI-powered layout generation, design suggestions, component detection, and batch design operations. Built for modern product design workflows.

tools.name: Locofy.ai
tools.description: Convert Figma and Adobe XD designs to production frontend code.
tools.longDescription: Locofy converts designs from Figma and Adobe XD into production-ready frontend code. It supports React, Next.js, React Native, HTML/CSS, and more. The AI understands responsive design, component structure, and can generate code that follows your team's coding standards.

tools.name: Tripetto
tools.description: Conversational form builder with AI-powered logic and personalization.
tools.longDescription: Tripetto creates engaging conversational forms and surveys with AI-powered logic branching. It embeds directly into websites and uses smart conditional logic to create personalized form experiences that increase completion rates.

tools.name: vidIQ
tools.description: AI-powered YouTube growth tool for SEO, analytics, and content ideas.
tools.longDescription: vidIQ helps YouTube creators grow their channels with AI-powered tools. Features include keyword research, SEO optimization, competitor analysis, daily content ideas, and an AI coach that provides personalized growth strategies based on your channel data.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier. Pro at $16.58/mo. Boost at $49.92/mo.

tools.name: TubeBuddy
tools.description: YouTube channel management and optimization toolkit with AI features.
tools.longDescription: TubeBuddy is a browser extension and mobile app for YouTube channel management. AI features include title and description generators, thumbnail A/B testing, SEO optimization, and bulk processing tools. Used by millions of creators for channel growth.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier. Pro at $4.50/mo. Legend at $24.50/mo.

tools.name: Limitless AI
tools.description: AI pendant and app that captures conversations and creates perfect memory.
tools.longDescription: Limitless (formerly Rewind) offers a wearable AI pendant and companion app that captures conversations throughout your day. It provides meeting summaries, action items, and searchable transcripts. The pendant works independently of your phone or computer.
tools.pricingDetails: Free app. Pendant at $99. Pro at $19/mo.

tools.name: Dust
tools.description: Platform for building custom AI assistants connected to your company data.
tools.longDescription: Dust lets companies build custom AI assistants that connect to their internal data sources. Create specialized agents for different teams — engineering, sales, support — each with access to relevant knowledge from Notion, Slack, GitHub, and more.

tools.name: Exa
tools.description: Neural search engine for finding exactly what AI agents need.
tools.longDescription: Exa (formerly Metaphor) is a neural search engine built for AI. It uses embeddings-based search to find the most relevant results, going beyond keyword matching. Ideal for AI agents that need to find specific types of content, people, companies, or research.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 1000 searches/mo. Plans from $49/mo.

tools.name: Rive
tools.description: AI-enhanced interactive animation tool for apps and games.
tools.longDescription: Rive is an animation tool that creates interactive, real-time animations for apps, games, and websites. Its AI features help generate animations from descriptions, suggest transitions, and optimize animation performance. Animations run natively on all platforms.

tools.name: ElevenLabs Dubbing
tools.description: AI video dubbing that translates and lip-syncs in 29+ languages.
tools.longDescription: ElevenLabs' AI Dubbing automatically translates and dubs video content into 29+ languages. It preserves the original speaker's voice characteristics, matches lip movements, and maintains emotional tone. Ideal for content creators expanding to global audiences.
tools.pricingDetails: Included in ElevenLabs plans from $5/mo. Per-minute pricing for high volume.

tools.name: Rask AI
tools.description: AI video translation and localization with voice cloning and lip-sync.
tools.longDescription: Rask AI localizes video content into 130+ languages with AI voice cloning, lip-sync, and subtitle generation. It preserves the original speaker's voice while translating, making it easy for creators and businesses to reach global audiences.
tools.pricingDetails: Basic at $60/mo. Pro at $140/mo. Enterprise custom.

tools.name: Beehiiv
tools.description: Newsletter platform with AI writing, growth tools, and monetization.
tools.longDescription: Beehiiv is a newsletter platform built for growth, featuring AI writing assistance, subscriber recommendations, referral programs, and built-in monetization through ads and premium subscriptions. Used by top newsletter creators and media companies.
tools.pricingDetails: Free up to 2,500 subscribers. Scale at $39/mo. Max at $99/mo.
cons: Some features locked to higher tiers

tools.name: Castmagic
tools.description: AI that turns podcast and video recordings into multi-format content.
tools.longDescription: Castmagic transforms audio and video recordings into dozens of content formats using AI. Upload a podcast episode and get show notes, blog posts, social posts, email newsletters, quotes, timestamps, and more. Includes custom prompt templates for consistent output.
tools.pricingDetails: Starter at $23/mo. Pro at $49/mo. Enterprise custom.

tools.name: Firecrawl
tools.description: AI-ready web scraping API that turns websites into clean LLM-ready data.
tools.longDescription: Firecrawl crawls and converts websites into clean, structured data ready for LLM consumption. It handles JavaScript rendering, pagination, and anti-bot measures. Returns clean markdown or structured data perfect for RAG, fine-tuning, and AI agent use cases.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 500 credits. Hobby at $19/mo. Standard at $49/mo.

tools.name: Crawl4AI
tools.description: Open-source web crawler optimized for AI and large language models.
tools.longDescription: Crawl4AI is an open-source web crawling framework designed for AI applications. It extracts clean, structured content from websites with built-in support for JavaScript rendering, chunking strategies, and LLM-friendly output formats. Easy to use with async support.

tools.name: Jina Reader
tools.description: Convert any URL to LLM-friendly text with a simple API prefix.
tools.longDescription: Jina Reader converts any web page into clean, LLM-friendly markdown by simply prepending r.jina.ai/ to any URL. No API key needed for basic use. Also offers search capabilities, grounding, and structured data extraction for AI applications.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier with 1M tokens/day. Premium for higher limits.

tools.name: Langflow
tools.description: Visual framework for building multi-agent AI applications with drag-and-drop.
tools.longDescription: Langflow is a visual framework for building AI applications using a drag-and-drop interface. Create complex multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI applications by connecting components visually. Supports LangChain, custom Python, and multiple LLM providers.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. DataStax cloud hosting available.

tools.name: tldraw Make Real
tools.description: Draw wireframes and AI converts them to working web applications.
tools.longDescription: tldraw's Make Real feature lets you draw rough wireframes and UI sketches on a canvas, then AI converts them into working HTML/CSS/JavaScript applications. It's an incredibly fast way to prototype ideas by literally drawing them.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. API key required for AI features.

tools.name: Podium
tools.description: AI podcast player that creates personalized daily podcasts from your feeds.
tools.longDescription: Podium uses AI to create personalized daily podcast summaries from your subscriptions and interests. It generates natural-sounding audio digests of the most relevant episodes and news, saving hours of listening time while keeping you informed.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier. Premium for more personalization.

tools.name: Wondercraft
tools.description: AI podcast studio for creating complete podcasts from text.
tools.longDescription: Wondercraft is an AI-powered podcast creation studio. Write or paste text, select AI voices, add music, and generate complete podcast episodes. Features include multi-speaker support, voice cloning, background music, and distribution to major platforms.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier. Creator at $19/mo. Pro at $49/mo.

tools.name: Ray.so
tools.description: Create beautiful code snippets for sharing.
tools.longDescription: Ray.so lets you create beautiful, shareable images of your code with syntax highlighting, custom themes, and padding options. Perfect for social media, documentation, and presentations.

tools.name: Carbon
tools.description: Create and share beautiful images of your source code.
tools.longDescription: Carbon makes it easy to create and share beautiful images of your source code. Start with importing code directly from GitHub gists or pasting it in, customize the styling, then share.

tools.name: Snappify
tools.description: Create stunning code presentations and snippets.
tools.longDescription: Snappify is a powerful tool for creating beautiful code-based presentations, animations, and social media content. Features rich editor with code animations, export to image/video.

tools.name: GitLens
tools.description: Supercharge Git inside VS Code with AI insights.
tools.longDescription: GitLens supercharges Git within VS Code. Visualize code authorship, navigate revisions, and understand code evolution with rich hovers, blame annotations, and AI-powered commit summaries.
cons: Can slow VS Code on large repos

tools.name: Sourcegraph
tools.description: Universal code search across all repositories.
tools.longDescription: Sourcegraph provides code search and intelligence across all your repositories and code hosts. Search every branch and commit with regex, structural search, and AI-powered code navigation.

tools.name: Mutable AI
tools.longDescription: Mutable AI helps teams understand and improve codebases with automated documentation, code refactoring suggestions, and intelligent codebase chat. Integrates with GitHub.

tools.name: CodeSnippets.ai
tools.description: AI-powered code snippet library for teams.
tools.longDescription: CodeSnippets.ai helps teams organize, share, and discover code snippets powered by AI. Automatically tags, categorizes, and suggests relevant snippets based on your current work.

tools.name: Stepsize AI
tools.description: AI-powered sprint reports and engineering insights.
tools.longDescription: Stepsize automatically generates sprint reports, identifies engineering bottlenecks, and provides insights from your development workflow. Integrates with Jira, Linear, and GitHub.

tools.name: GitBook
tools.longDescription: GitBook provides a collaborative documentation platform where teams can create, edit, and publish docs. Features AI-powered search, Git sync, and beautiful published sites.

tools.name: Swimm
tools.description: AI-created documentation that stays up to date.
tools.longDescription: Swimm uses AI to generate and continuously update documentation coupled to your code. When code changes, docs auto-update. Integrates into IDEs and CI/CD.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for small teams. Pro from $19/user/mo.

tools.name: Railway
tools.description: Deploy code instantly with zero configuration.
tools.longDescription: Railway lets you deploy code from GitHub in seconds. Supports Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, and more. Features automatic builds, free database provisioning, and simple scaling.
tools.pricingDetails: Free trial with $5 credit. Usage-based pricing.

tools.name: Render
tools.description: Cloud platform for building and running apps.
tools.longDescription: Render is a unified cloud to build and run all your apps with free SSL, global CDN, private networking, and auto deploys from Git. Supports static sites, web services, and databases.

tools.name: PlanetScale
tools.longDescription: PlanetScale offers a serverless MySQL-compatible database with branching, non-blocking schema changes, and unlimited scalability. Built on Vitess, the technology behind YouTube's database.

tools.name: Val Town
tools.description: Social coding platform for cloud functions.
tools.longDescription: Val Town lets you write, run, and share small scripts in the cloud. Create HTTP endpoints, cron jobs, and email handlers with instant deployment. Like a social network for code.

tools.name: StackBlitz
tools.description: Instant full-stack dev environments in the browser.
tools.longDescription: StackBlitz provides instant, full-stack web development environments that boot in milliseconds. Powered by WebContainers, it runs Node.js natively in the browser.

tools.name: CodeSandbox
tools.description: Online code editor for rapid web development.
tools.longDescription: CodeSandbox is a cloud development platform for building, sharing, and deploying web projects. Features instant environments, live collaboration, and AI-assisted coding.

tools.name: CodePen
tools.description: Social coding environment for front-end design.
tools.longDescription: CodePen is an online code editor for building and sharing front-end web projects. Write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with live preview, and explore millions of community pens.

tools.name: Postman
tools.longDescription: Postman simplifies API development with tools for designing, testing, documenting, and sharing APIs. Features include automated testing, mock servers, and team collaboration workspaces.
cons: Desktop app required for full features

tools.name: Hoppscotch
tools.longDescription: Hoppscotch is a fast, open-source API development tool. Supports REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and more. Lightweight alternative to Postman that runs entirely in the browser.

tools.name: Insomnia
tools.description: Open-source API client for REST and GraphQL.
tools.longDescription: Insomnia is an open-source, cross-platform API client for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and WebSockets. Features environment management, code generation, and team sync.

tools.name: HTTPie
tools.longDescription: HTTPie is a command-line and web-based HTTP client that makes API testing intuitive. Features syntax highlighting, JSON support, and a beautiful web UI for exploring APIs.

tools.name: Nx
tools.longDescription: Nx is a powerful build system for monorepo management. Features intelligent task caching, dependency graph visualization, and affected commands to only rebuild what changed.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. Nx Cloud from $8/contributor/mo.

tools.name: Turborepo
tools.description: High-performance build system for JavaScript monorepos.
tools.longDescription: Turborepo is an incremental build system optimized for JavaScript and TypeScript monorepos. Features remote caching, parallel execution, and minimal configuration.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source. Vercel managed caching.

tools.name: Zotero
tools.description: Free reference manager and research organizer.
tools.longDescription: Zotero helps you collect, organize, annotate, cite, and share research. Save references from your browser with one click and generate citations in any format.

tools.name: Mendeley
tools.description: Reference manager and academic social network.
tools.longDescription: Mendeley combines a reference manager with an academic social network. Manage PDFs, generate citations, collaborate with researchers, and discover new papers.

tools.name: Paperpal
tools.description: AI academic writing and editing assistant.
tools.longDescription: Paperpal helps researchers write better academic papers. Features language editing, grammar corrections, consistency checks, and journal submission readiness assessment.

tools.name: Writefull
tools.description: AI writing support for academic texts.
tools.longDescription: Writefull provides AI-powered language feedback specifically for academic writing. Trained on millions of published papers to suggest improvements aligned with academic conventions.

tools.name: Inciteful
tools.longDescription: Inciteful builds citation networks from seed papers to help you understand research landscapes. Find important papers, emerging topics, and connections between fields.

tools.name: TickTick
tools.description: All-in-one task and time management app.
tools.longDescription: TickTick combines tasks, calendar, habits, and Pomodoro timer in one app. Features natural language input, Eisenhower matrix, and built-in white noise for focus.

tools.name: Fantastical
tools.description: Beautiful calendar app with natural language.
tools.longDescription: Fantastical is a powerful calendar app with natural language event creation, weather integration, calendar sets, and beautiful UI. Features Openings for easy scheduling with others.

tools.name: Toggl Track
tools.description: Simple time tracking for teams and freelancers.
tools.longDescription: Toggl Track makes time tracking effortless with one-click timers, calendar integration, and detailed reports. Features project tracking, team management, and billable rates.
cons: Separate billing for other Toggl products

tools.name: Clockify
tools.description: Free time tracking app for teams.
tools.longDescription: Clockify is the most popular free time tracking app. Track work hours, create timesheets, generate reports, and manage projects. Free for unlimited users.

tools.name: Raycast
tools.description: Blazing fast productivity launcher for macOS.
tools.longDescription: Raycast replaces Spotlight with a supercharged launcher. Features AI chat, clipboard history, snippets, window management, and thousands of extensions for developer workflows.

tools.name: Alfred
tools.longDescription: Alfred is a productivity powerhouse for macOS. Features include custom workflows, clipboard history, snippets, file search, and the powerful Powerpack for automation.

tools.name: Vecteezy AI
tools.description: AI image generator integrated with stock library.
tools.longDescription: Vecteezy combines an AI image generator with a massive stock photo and vector library. Generate images or find stock assets with integrated commercial licensing.

tools.name: Webflow
tools.description: Visual web design and CMS platform.
tools.longDescription: Webflow combines visual design tools with a powerful CMS and hosting. Build responsive websites visually with the power of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no coding required.

tools.name: Polotno Studio
tools.longDescription: Polotno Studio is a free, open-source graphic design editor similar to Canva. Create social media posts, presentations, and marketing materials with templates and design tools.

tools.name: Coolors
tools.longDescription: Coolors generates beautiful color schemes instantly. Press spacebar to generate, lock colors you like, and explore millions of community palettes. Export to any format.

tools.name: Brandwatch
tools.description: AI social listening and consumer intelligence.
tools.longDescription: Brandwatch monitors millions of online conversations to provide consumer insights, brand monitoring, and trend detection. AI-powered sentiment analysis across social media and web.

tools.name: Mention
tools.description: Real-time media monitoring and social listening.
tools.longDescription: Mention monitors the web, social media, forums, and news for brand mentions. Get real-time alerts, sentiment analysis, and competitive intelligence across millions of sources.

tools.name: Kit (ConvertKit)
tools.longDescription: Kit (formerly ConvertKit) is email marketing built for creators — bloggers, YouTubers, podcasters, and musicians. Features visual automations, landing pages, and digital product sales.

tools.name: Hunter.io
tools.description: Find and verify professional email addresses.
tools.longDescription: Hunter.io helps you find email addresses associated with any domain. Features include email finder, email verifier, cold email campaigns, and CRM integrations.

tools.name: Hotjar
tools.longDescription: Hotjar shows how users interact with your website through heatmaps, session recordings, and surveys. Understand user behavior, identify friction points, and improve conversion rates.

tools.name: Ahrefs
tools.description: Comprehensive SEO toolset and backlink analyzer.
tools.longDescription: Ahrefs is one of the most powerful SEO tools available. Features include site explorer, keyword research, content explorer, rank tracker, and the web's largest backlink index.

tools.name: Obsidian
tools.description: Private knowledge base with linked notes.
tools.longDescription: Obsidian is a powerful note-taking app that stores notes as local Markdown files. Features include bi-directional linking, graph view, plugins, and complete data ownership.

tools.name: Roam Research
tools.longDescription: Roam Research pioneered bi-directional linking for note-taking. Build a graph of connected ideas through daily notes, page references, and block-level linking.

tools.name: Loom
tools.longDescription: Loom lets you record your screen and camera to share video messages with your team. Faster than meetings, more personal than email. AI generates titles, summaries, and chapters.
tools.founder: Joe Thomas, Vinay Hiremath, Shahed Khan

tools.name: Cal.com
tools.longDescription: Cal.com is the open-source alternative to Calendly. Self-host or use the cloud version for scheduling with full customization, team features, and developer-friendly API.

tools.name: Wolfram Alpha
tools.longDescription: Wolfram Alpha computes answers using curated data and algorithms. Solves math, provides statistics, analyzes data, and answers factual questions with step-by-step solutions.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.description: Frontend deployment platform for web applications.
tools.longDescription: Vercel provides instant deployments for frontend frameworks. Features include edge functions, analytics, A/B testing, and seamless integration with Next.js, the framework they created.

tools.name: Netlify
tools.description: Web development platform for modern websites.
tools.longDescription: Netlify provides hosting, serverless functions, and a complete web development workflow. Features include deploy previews, form handling, identity management, and edge functions.

tools.name: Prisma
tools.description: Next-generation ORM for Node.js and TypeScript.
tools.longDescription: Prisma provides a type-safe database client, migration tool, and visual database browser. Makes database access easy and safe with auto-generated, type-safe queries.

tools.name: Docker
tools.description: Container platform for building and shipping apps.
tools.longDescription: Docker enables developers to package applications into containers — standardized units that include everything needed to run. The industry standard for containerization.

tools.name: Publii

tools.name: Ghost Starter Theme

tools.name: Bazel

tools.name: Meson

tools.name: Buck2

tools.name: Please Build

tools.name: sccache
tools.longDescription: sccache provides a shared compilation cache by Mozilla. Cache C, C++, and Rust compilation results across machines for dramatically faster rebuilds.

tools.name: ccache
tools.longDescription: ccache provides a compiler cache for C and C++. Caches compilation results to speed up recompilation — 5-10x faster rebuilds for incremental changes.

tools.name: mold

tools.name: Zig Build System
tools.longDescription: Zig's build system cross-compiles C, C++, and Zig code to any target. Drop-in replacement for system C compilers with cross-compilation without Docker.

tools.name: Nix Flakes
tools.longDescription: Nix Flakes provide reproducible development environments with lockfiles. Define exact tool versions, dependencies, and configuration for consistent dev environments.

tools.name: Firefox Developer Tools
tools.longDescription: Firefox Developer Tools provide built-in browser debugging. Grid inspector, Flexbox inspector, CSS changes, accessibility inspector, and performance tools.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools
tools.longDescription: Chrome DevTools provide built-in browser debugging. Elements, Console, Network, Performance, Sources, and Application panels for web development and debugging.

tools.name: Similarweb Browser Extension
tools.longDescription: Similarweb's browser extension shows estimated traffic, ranking, and engagement metrics for any website. Quick competitive intelligence while browsing.

tools.name: tmux Configuration

tools.name: tmux-sensible
tools.longDescription: tmux-sensible provides sensible default settings for tmux. Key bindings, scrollback, and options that should have been defaults for a better tmux experience.

tools.name: LilyPond

tools.name: Olive 0.2
tools.longDescription: Olive 0.2 provides the latest stable release of Olive video editor. Basic timeline editing, transitions, and effects for free, open-source video editing.

tools.name: LMSYS Chatbot Arena Leaderboard
tools.longDescription: The LMSYS Chatbot Arena Leaderboard ranks AI models by human preference. Crowdsourced ELO ratings from blind comparisons of model responses.

tools.name: MMLU

tools.name: Awesome AI Agents
tools.longDescription: A curated list of AI agent frameworks, tools, and applications. LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGPT, and emerging agent platforms organized by category.

tools.name: Awesome ChatGPT Prompts

tools.name: AI Art Resources
tools.description: Tools and guides for AI art.
tools.longDescription: Collections of AI art resources including model guides, workflow tutorials, ControlNet techniques, and prompt engineering for AI image generation.

tools.name: MkDocs Plugins
tools.longDescription: MkDocs plugins extend documentation site functionality. Search, macros, redirects, and PDF generation through a growing plugin ecosystem.

tools.name: Docusaurus Plugins
tools.longDescription: Docusaurus plugins add functionality to documentation sites. Search (Algolia), analytics, diagrams (Mermaid), and custom pages through official and community plugins.

tools.name: Protocol Buffers
tools.longDescription: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) provides language-neutral, platform-neutral binary serialization. Define data structures once and generate code for C++, Java, Python, Go, and more.

tools.name: gRPC
tools.longDescription: gRPC provides a high-performance, open-source RPC framework. HTTP/2, Protocol Buffers, streaming, and code generation for building distributed systems.

tools.name: GraphQL
tools.longDescription: GraphQL provides a query language for APIs. Clients request exactly the data they need, enabling efficient data fetching with a single endpoint and type system.

tools.name: OpenAPI 3.1
tools.longDescription: OpenAPI 3.1 provides the latest REST API description standard. Full JSON Schema compatibility, webhooks, and improved reusability for API documentation.

tools.name: JSON:API
tools.longDescription: JSON:API provides a specification for building APIs in JSON. Standardized request/response format with sparse fieldsets, includes, pagination, and filtering.

tools.name: REST
tools.longDescription: REST (Representational State Transfer) provides an architectural style for web APIs. Stateless, resource-based with HTTP methods — the most common API pattern.

tools.name: Swagger UI
tools.longDescription: Swagger UI generates interactive API documentation from OpenAPI specifications. Try API endpoints directly from the browser with auto-generated request forms.

tools.name: cURL
tools.longDescription: cURL provides a command-line tool for transferring data with URLs. HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, and dozens of protocols for testing APIs, downloading files, and scripting.

tools.name: Wget
tools.longDescription: Wget provides a non-interactive network downloader. Recursively download websites, retry failed transfers, and mirror sites with GNU Wget's robust downloading.

tools.name: aria2
tools.longDescription: aria2 provides a lightweight multi-protocol, multi-source download utility. BitTorrent, HTTP, FTP with multiple connections per download for maximum speed.

tools.name: Safari Web Inspector
tools.longDescription: Safari Web Inspector provides built-in development tools for debugging web applications on macOS and iOS. Elements, Console, Network, and responsive design mode.

tools.name: Website Speed Test Tools
tools.longDescription: A collection of website speed testing tools for measuring and comparing page performance. Lighthouse, WebPageTest, GTmetrix, and Pingdom for comprehensive analysis.

tools.name: Git Configuration
tools.longDescription: Git's configuration system customizes behavior through .gitconfig. Set aliases, default branch names, pull strategies, and UI preferences globally or per-repository.

tools.name: Git Aliases
tools.longDescription: Git aliases create shortcuts for common Git commands. Set up co (checkout), st (status), br (branch), and custom command pipelines for faster Git workflows.

tools.name: Sibelius
tools.longDescription: Sibelius by Avid provides professional music notation software. Create, edit, and publish scores with professional engraving quality for film, TV, and publishing.

tools.name: Finale
tools.longDescription: Finale provides professional music notation software with deep engraving control. Create any notation with precise layout, articulations, and playback for professional publications.

tools.name: Nuke
tools.longDescription: Nuke provides professional visual effects compositing used in Hollywood. Node-based workflow with 3D compositing, deep compositing, and particle systems.

tools.name: Houdini
tools.longDescription: Houdini provides procedural 3D animation and visual effects. Node-based workflow for simulations, particles, destruction, and procedural modeling used in film.

tools.name: Anthropic Safety Research
tools.longDescription: Anthropic publishes AI safety research including constitutional AI, RLHF, interpretability, and alignment. Leading AI safety research informing Claude's development.

tools.name: OpenAI Safety Research
tools.longDescription: OpenAI publishes AI safety and alignment research. Superalignment, red-teaming, interpretability, and governance for building safe AI systems.

tools.name: Distill.pub
tools.longDescription: Distill.pub provided beautifully interactive machine learning research explanations. Pioneered interactive visualizations for explaining complex ML concepts clearly.

tools.name: 3Blue1Brown
tools.longDescription: 3Blue1Brown by Grant Sanderson provides beautifully animated math and ML explainer videos. Neural networks, linear algebra, calculus, and more made intuitive.

tools.name: GFPGAN
tools.longDescription: GFPGAN provides AI-powered face restoration for old, blurry, or low-quality photos. Restore facial details with GAN-based processing for photorealistic enhancement.

tools.name: Real-ESRGAN
tools.longDescription: Real-ESRGAN provides practical AI image restoration and upscaling. Enhance real-world images with anime and general models for 4x resolution improvement.

tools.name: WakaTime
tools.longDescription: WakaTime automatically tracks your coding time by language, project, and editor. See how you spend your development time with dashboards and weekly reports.

tools.name: FlatBuffers
tools.longDescription: FlatBuffers provides memory-efficient serialization by Google. Access data without parsing or unpacking — used in games, mobile apps, and performance-critical applications.

tools.name: MessagePack
tools.longDescription: MessagePack provides efficient binary serialization — like JSON but faster and smaller. Binary format with multi-language support for data exchange and storage.

tools.name: Cap'n Proto
tools.longDescription: Cap'n Proto provides serialization that's so fast, it competes with raw struct access. Zero-copy, zero-encoding overhead for ultra-performance data interchange.

tools.name: Apache Avro
tools.longDescription: Apache Avro provides rich data serialization with compact binary format, schemas, and schema evolution. Used extensively in Apache Kafka and Hadoop ecosystems.

tools.name: Apache Thrift
tools.longDescription: Apache Thrift provides a cross-language services framework. Define data types and service interfaces in IDL, generate code for 20+ languages, and build distributed systems.

tools.name: JSON-RPC
tools.longDescription: JSON-RPC provides a simple, stateless RPC protocol using JSON. Send method calls and receive results over any transport — simpler than REST for some use cases.

tools.name: WebSocket
tools.longDescription: WebSocket provides full-duplex communication channels over a single TCP connection. Real-time, bidirectional data transfer between client and server.

tools.name: Server-Sent Events
tools.longDescription: Server-Sent Events (SSE) provide a simple mechanism for server-to-client streaming. One-way event stream over HTTP — simpler than WebSocket for many use cases.

tools.name: Webhooks
tools.longDescription: Webhooks provide HTTP callbacks for event-driven communication. When an event occurs, an HTTP POST is sent to a configured URL — the simplest integration pattern.

tools.name: Long Polling
tools.longDescription: Long polling maintains an HTTP connection until the server has new data. Simpler than WebSocket for infrequent server-to-client updates over standard HTTP.

tools.name: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
tools.longDescription: CLS measures visual stability — how much the page layout shifts during loading. Part of Core Web Vitals, CLS should be below 0.1 for good user experience.

tools.name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
tools.longDescription: LCP measures loading performance — how long until the largest content element is visible. Should be under 2.5 seconds for good Core Web Vitals score.

tools.name: Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
tools.longDescription: INP measures responsiveness — how long until the page updates after user interaction. Replaced FID as a Core Web Vital, should be under 200ms.

tools.name: WebPageTest API
tools.longDescription: WebPageTest API runs performance tests programmatically. Schedule tests from 40+ locations with custom settings and get detailed performance reports.

tools.name: Git Worktrees
tools.longDescription: Git worktrees create multiple working directories from a single repo. Work on different branches simultaneously without stashing or cloning.

tools.name: Git Bisect
tools.longDescription: Git bisect performs a binary search through commit history to find the commit that introduced a bug. Automatically or manually test commits to isolate the problem.

tools.name: Git Stash
tools.longDescription: Git stash temporarily shelves changes to your working directory. Save incomplete work, switch branches, and restore changes later with named stashes.

tools.name: Noteflight
tools.longDescription: Noteflight provides online music notation in the browser. Create, edit, and share scores with playback, collaboration, and no software installation required.

tools.name: DaVinci Resolve Fairlight
tools.longDescription: Fairlight in DaVinci Resolve provides professional audio post-production. Multi-track mixing, effects, ADR, Foley, and immersive audio for film and TV.

tools.name: LLM Comparison Tools
tools.longDescription: Various tools and benchmarks for comparing LLM capabilities. MMLU, HumanEval, MT-Bench, and arena ratings for informed model selection.

tools.name: W&B Guides
tools.longDescription: Weights & Biases Guides provide tutorials and best practices for ML experimentation. Hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation, and production ML patterns.

tools.name: CodeFormer
tools.longDescription: CodeFormer provides robust face restoration using AI. Fix old, damaged, or AI-generated faces with a controllable balance between fidelity and quality.

tools.name: MDX Embed
tools.longDescription: MDX Embed provides React components for embedding social media content in MDX. YouTube, Twitter, Instagram, CodePen, and more with simple component imports.

tools.name: HTTP/2
tools.longDescription: HTTP/2 provides a major revision of HTTP with multiplexing, header compression, server push, and binary framing for dramatically faster web performance.

tools.name: HTTP/3
tools.longDescription: HTTP/3 uses QUIC transport for faster, more reliable web connections. Eliminates head-of-line blocking with UDP-based transport for improved performance.

tools.name: OAuth 2.0
tools.longDescription: OAuth 2.0 provides an authorization framework for delegated access. Access tokens, refresh tokens, and authorization flows for secure third-party API access.

tools.name: OpenID Connect
tools.longDescription: OpenID Connect adds an identity layer to OAuth 2.0. Verify user identity, get profile information, and implement single sign-on with standardized claims.

tools.name: JSON Web Tokens
tools.longDescription: JWT provides a compact, URL-safe token format for securely transmitting information. Claims-based with digital signatures for stateless authentication and authorization.

tools.name: Content Security Policy
tools.longDescription: CSP provides a security layer for preventing XSS and data injection attacks. Define which resources can load through HTTP headers or meta tags.

tools.name: Subresource Integrity
tools.longDescription: SRI verifies that external resources haven't been tampered with. Add integrity hashes to script and link tags to ensure CDN resources haven't been modified.

tools.name: Web Crypto API
tools.longDescription: The Web Crypto API provides cryptographic operations in the browser. Generate keys, encrypt/decrypt data, sign/verify, and hash without external libraries.

tools.name: Service Workers
tools.longDescription: Service Workers provide a proxy between web apps and the network. Enable offline functionality, push notifications, and background sync for progressive web apps.

tools.name: Web Animations API
tools.longDescription: The Web Animations API provides animation capabilities natively in the browser. Animate DOM elements with JavaScript control and CSS animation performance.

tools.name: Intersection Observer API
tools.longDescription: Intersection Observer detects when elements enter or exit the viewport. Efficient, scroll-based triggers for lazy loading, infinite scroll, and animation.

tools.name: Resize Observer API
tools.longDescription: Resize Observer monitors element size changes. Responsive components, auto-fitting text, and dynamic layouts that react to container resizing.

tools.name: Mutation Observer API
tools.longDescription: Mutation Observer watches for changes to the DOM tree. Detect added/removed nodes, attribute changes, and text content modifications efficiently.

tools.name: Schema.org Guide
tools.longDescription: Google's guide to implementing Schema.org structured data. JSON-LD examples, required properties, and testing tools for achieving rich results in search.

tools.name: Git Rebase
tools.longDescription: Git rebase rewrites commit history by replaying changes. Interactive rebase for squashing, reordering, and editing commits for clean, linear history.

tools.name: Git Cherry-pick
tools.longDescription: Git cherry-pick applies specific commits from one branch to another. Pick individual changes without merging entire branches for selective code sharing.

tools.name: PreSonus Studio One Prime
tools.longDescription: Studio One Prime provides a free, full-featured DAW by PreSonus. Record, edit, and mix audio with unlimited tracks, virtual instruments, and native effects.

tools.name: WebCodecs API
tools.longDescription: WebCodecs API provides low-level access to video and audio codecs in the browser. Encode, decode, and process media frames for video editing and streaming apps.

tools.name: AI Model Pricing Comparison
tools.longDescription: Tools and resources for comparing AI model pricing across providers. Token costs, rate limits, and value analysis for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and others.

tools.name: Paperspace Gradient
tools.longDescription: Gradient by Paperspace provides ML development notebooks, workflows, and deployment. Free GPU notebooks for training and experimentation on their cloud.

tools.name: Stable Video Diffusion
tools.longDescription: Stable Video Diffusion by Stability AI generates short video clips from single images. Create 2-4 second motion videos with consistent quality and motion.

tools.name: Performance API
tools.longDescription: The Performance API provides high-resolution timestamps and performance metrics. Measure navigation timing, resource loading, and custom marks for precise performance analysis.

tools.name: BroadcastChannel API
tools.longDescription: BroadcastChannel API enables communication between browser tabs and windows. Send messages between same-origin browsing contexts for synchronized experiences.

tools.name: Web Workers
tools.longDescription: Web Workers run JavaScript in background threads. Perform CPU-intensive tasks without blocking the main UI thread for responsive web applications.

tools.name: Shared Workers
tools.longDescription: Shared Workers run in a background thread accessible from multiple pages. Share a single worker instance between tabs for efficient resource usage.

tools.name: IndexedDB
tools.longDescription: IndexedDB provides a low-level API for client-side storage of structured data. Store large amounts of data in the browser with indexes and transactions.

tools.name: Dexie.js
tools.longDescription: Dexie.js provides a simpler wrapper around IndexedDB. Promise-based API with table definitions, queries, and compound indexes for easy client-side data management.

tools.name: localForage
tools.longDescription: localForage provides a simple localStorage-like API backed by IndexedDB, WebSQL, and localStorage. Store files, blobs, and typed arrays with a familiar interface.

tools.name: Cache API
tools.longDescription: The Cache API provides programmatic control of HTTP request/response caching. Store API responses, assets, and resources for offline-first applications.

tools.name: File API
tools.longDescription: The File API provides access to files selected by the user. Read file contents, get metadata, and process user-uploaded files in browser applications.

tools.name: Streams API
tools.longDescription: The Streams API provides a standard for creating, composing, and consuming streams in JavaScript. ReadableStream, WritableStream, and TransformStream for efficient data processing.

tools.name: Clipboard API
tools.longDescription: The Clipboard API provides async read/write access to the system clipboard. Copy text, images, and rich content programmatically with user permission.

tools.name: Geolocation API
tools.longDescription: The Geolocation API provides access to the device's geographic position. Get latitude, longitude, altitude, and accuracy with user permission.

tools.name: Notifications API
tools.longDescription: The Notifications API creates native desktop/mobile notifications from web apps. Display alerts with icons, actions, and click handling outside the browser tab.

tools.name: HTML Drag and Drop API
tools.longDescription: The HTML Drag and Drop API enables native drag-and-drop interactions. Drag elements, transfer data, and handle drop events with browser-native behavior.

tools.name: CSS Media Queries
tools.longDescription: CSS Media Queries apply styles based on device characteristics. Viewport width, orientation, color scheme, and reduced motion for responsive, accessible designs.

tools.name: prefers-color-scheme
tools.longDescription: prefers-color-scheme CSS media query detects the user's system color scheme preference. Apply light or dark styles automatically based on OS settings.

tools.name: prefers-reduced-motion
tools.longDescription: prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query detects if the user prefers reduced motion. Disable or reduce animations for users with motion sensitivity.

tools.name: robots.txt
tools.longDescription: robots.txt tells search engine crawlers which pages to access. Standard for controlling crawl behavior, rate limiting, and sitemap references.

tools.name: XML Sitemap
tools.longDescription: XML Sitemaps list your website pages for search engines. Help crawlers discover content, set priorities, and indicate update frequencies for better indexing.

tools.name: Git Flow
tools.longDescription: Git Flow provides a branching model for Git. Feature, release, and hotfix branches with a structured workflow for managing software releases.

tools.name: Trunk-Based Development
tools.longDescription: Trunk-Based Development keeps all developers working on a single main branch. Short-lived feature branches, feature flags, and continuous integration for fast delivery.

tools.name: GitHub Flow
tools.longDescription: GitHub Flow provides a lightweight, branch-based workflow. Create a branch, add commits, open a PR, discuss, merge — simple and effective for continuous deployment.

tools.name: Ableton Live Lite
tools.longDescription: Ableton Live Lite provides a free, limited version of Ableton Live. 16 tracks, core instruments, and effects for learning music production and beat making.

tools.name: MediaSource API
tools.longDescription: MediaSource API enables JavaScript to generate media streams for playback. Power adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS/DASH) and custom media pipelines in the browser.

tools.name: Claude Model Card
tools.longDescription: Anthropic's model cards document Claude's capabilities, limitations, intended uses, and safety evaluations. Transparent documentation of model behavior.

tools.name: Python Type Hints
tools.longDescription: Python type hints provide optional static typing annotations. Type checkers like mypy verify correctness at development time for catching bugs before runtime.

tools.name: WebP Format
tools.longDescription: WebP provides modern image compression with both lossy and lossless modes. 25-35% smaller than JPEG/PNG with transparency and animation support.

tools.name: AVIF Format
tools.longDescription: AVIF provides next-generation image compression based on AV1 video codec. 50% smaller than JPEG with HDR, transparency, and animation support.

tools.name: Conventional Changelog
tools.longDescription: Conventional Changelog generates changelogs from conventional commit messages. Automatically categorize changes by type and create release notes.

tools.name: Fetch API
tools.longDescription: The Fetch API provides a modern interface for making HTTP requests. Promise-based, streaming, and cleaner than XMLHttpRequest for network communication.

tools.name: AbortController
tools.longDescription: AbortController provides a way to cancel fetch requests and other async operations. Create signals that abort in-flight requests for timeouts and cleanup.

tools.name: URL API
tools.longDescription: The URL API provides utilities for parsing, constructing, and manipulating URLs. URLSearchParams for query strings, URL for parsing — replacing manual string manipulation.

tools.name: FormData API
tools.longDescription: The FormData API creates key/value pairs for form data submission. Build multipart/form-data programmatically for file uploads and form submissions.

tools.name: structuredClone
tools.longDescription: structuredClone provides built-in deep cloning of JavaScript objects. Clone nested objects, arrays, dates, maps, sets, and more without external libraries.

tools.name: Promise.allSettled
tools.longDescription: Promise.allSettled waits for all promises to complete, whether fulfilled or rejected. Get results of all promises without short-circuiting on the first rejection.

tools.name: Optional Chaining
tools.longDescription: Optional chaining (?.) provides safe access to deeply nested object properties. Returns undefined instead of throwing when a reference is null or undefined.

tools.name: Nullish Coalescing
tools.longDescription: Nullish coalescing (??) provides a default value when the left operand is null or undefined. Unlike ||, it doesn't trigger on falsy values like 0 or empty string.

tools.name: Proxy API
tools.longDescription: JavaScript Proxy intercepts and customizes fundamental object operations. Get, set, delete, and apply traps for creating reactive systems and validation layers.

tools.name: Iterators and Generators
tools.longDescription: JavaScript iterators and generators provide custom iteration protocols. Create lazy sequences, infinite streams, and custom for...of behavior with yield.

tools.name: Async Iterators
tools.longDescription: Async iterators and generators provide asynchronous iteration. Use for await...of to iterate over async data sources like API pages, streams, and event sequences.

tools.name: Map and Set
tools.longDescription: JavaScript Map and Set provide modern collection types. Map for key-value pairs (any key type), Set for unique values — both with guaranteed iteration order.

tools.name: WeakRef and FinalizationRegistry
tools.longDescription: WeakRef holds a weak reference to an object that doesn't prevent garbage collection. FinalizationRegistry provides cleanup callbacks when objects are collected.

tools.name: Temporal API
tools.longDescription: The Temporal API provides a modern date and time API for JavaScript. Replaces Date with timezone-aware, immutable date handling that's actually correct.

tools.name: Import Maps
tools.longDescription: Import Maps define how bare module specifiers resolve in browsers. Map package names to URLs for using npm-style imports without a bundler.

tools.name: Container Query Units
tools.longDescription: CSS container query units (cqw, cqh, cqi, cqb) are relative to the size of a query container. Build truly responsive components that adapt to their container.

tools.name: Canonical URLs
tools.longDescription: Canonical URLs tell search engines which version of a page is the original. Prevent duplicate content penalties with rel=canonical for SEO best practices.

tools.name: .gitignore
tools.longDescription: A .gitignore file specifies which files and directories Git should ignore. Prevent committing build artifacts, dependencies, secrets, and editor files to your repository.

tools.name: gitignore.io
tools.longDescription: gitignore.io generates .gitignore files for any combination of operating systems, IDEs, and programming languages. Select your stack and get a complete ignore file.

tools.name: JavaScript.info
tools.longDescription: JavaScript.info provides a comprehensive, modern JavaScript tutorial. From basics to advanced topics with interactive examples and detailed explanations.

tools.name: SVG Format
tools.longDescription: SVG provides an XML-based vector image format for the web. Scalable to any size without quality loss, styleable with CSS, and scriptable with JavaScript.

tools.name: TC39 Proposals
tools.longDescription: TC39 proposals track upcoming JavaScript language features. Stages 0-4 show the path from initial idea to specification for new JS capabilities.

tools.name: ECMAScript Specification
tools.longDescription: The ECMAScript specification defines the JavaScript language standard. The authoritative reference for all JavaScript behavior, syntax, and built-in objects.

tools.name: WebAssembly Specification
tools.longDescription: The WebAssembly specification defines the WASM binary format, text format, JavaScript API, and web API for portable, secure, high-performance code execution.

tools.name: CSS Specification
tools.longDescription: W3C CSS specifications define the CSS language. Individual modules for Flexbox, Grid, Colors, Selectors, and more — the authoritative CSS reference.

tools.name: HTML Living Standard
tools.longDescription: The HTML Living Standard by WHATWG defines the HTML markup language. The authoritative, continuously updated specification for all HTML elements, attributes, and APIs.

tools.name: DOM Specification
tools.longDescription: The DOM specification defines the Document Object Model — the programming interface for web documents. Nodes, events, and API for JavaScript-HTML interaction.

tools.name: URL Standard
tools.longDescription: The URL Standard defines how URLs are parsed, serialized, and resolved. The authoritative reference for URL handling in browsers and libraries.

tools.name: Encoding Standard
tools.longDescription: The Encoding Standard defines text encoding labels and codecs. UTF-8, UTF-16, and legacy encodings for correct text handling in web applications.

tools.name: Console Standard
tools.longDescription: The Console Standard defines the console API — console.log, console.error, console.table, and other debugging methods used by every JavaScript developer.

tools.name: Storage Standard
tools.longDescription: The Storage Standard defines how web storage works. Quotas, eviction, permissions, and the relationship between localStorage, IndexedDB, Cache API, and other storage.

tools.name: JSON5
tools.longDescription: JSON5 extends JSON with comments, trailing commas, unquoted keys, multi-line strings, and more. Write configuration files that are both machine and human readable.

tools.name: TOML
tools.longDescription: TOML provides a minimal, clear configuration file format. Human-readable with obvious semantics — tables, key-values, arrays, and dates for application configuration.

tools.name: YAML
tools.longDescription: YAML provides a human-readable data serialization format. Used for configuration files, data exchange, and infrastructure-as-code with indentation-based structure.

tools.name: .env Files
tools.longDescription: The .env file convention stores environment variables in key-value format. Load configuration, secrets, and settings per-environment for 12-factor app development.

tools.name: Git Attributes
tools.longDescription: Git attributes customize how Git handles specific files. Set line endings, diff drivers, merge strategies, and language stats per file pattern.

tools.name: Node Version File (.nvmrc)
tools.longDescription: The .nvmrc file pins the Node.js version for a project. Version managers like nvm, fnm, and mise automatically use the specified version when entering the directory.

tools.name: .node-version
tools.longDescription: The .node-version file specifies which Node.js version to use. Simpler than .nvmrc, supported by fnm, nodenv, mise, and other version managers.

tools.name: .tool-versions
tools.longDescription: The .tool-versions file pins versions for multiple development tools. Used by asdf and mise to manage Node, Python, Ruby, Go, and more per project.

tools.name: LICENSE Files
tools.longDescription: LICENSE files declare the open-source license for your project. MIT, Apache 2.0, GPL, ISC, and others define how your code can be used, modified, and distributed.

tools.name: README.md
tools.longDescription: README.md provides the primary documentation for your project. Describe what your project does, how to install it, and how to use it in Markdown format.

tools.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
tools.longDescription: CONTRIBUTING.md provides guidelines for contributing to your project. Code style, PR process, issue templates, and development setup for open-source projects.

tools.name: Code of Conduct
tools.longDescription: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md establishes behavior standards for your project community. The Contributor Covenant is the most widely adopted code of conduct for open-source projects.

tools.name: SECURITY.md
tools.longDescription: SECURITY.md provides instructions for reporting security vulnerabilities. Define how to report, response timeline, and security patch process for responsible disclosure.

tools.name: CODEOWNERS
tools.longDescription: CODEOWNERS automatically assigns reviewers to pull requests. Define who owns which files and directories for automatic review assignment on GitHub.

tools.name: Dependabot Configuration
tools.longDescription: Dependabot configuration customizes automatic dependency updates. Set schedules, ecosystems, ignored versions, and reviewers for automated PR creation.

tools.name: GitHub Actions Workflow Syntax
tools.longDescription: GitHub Actions workflow syntax defines CI/CD pipelines in YAML. Jobs, steps, triggers, and expressions for automating builds, tests, and deployments.

tools.name: package.json
