It enables data teams to activate their data warehouse as a source of truth, pushing customer data, product usage, and analytics into CRM, marketing, and support tools without writing custom code.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for up to 10 syncs; paid from $800/mo

tools.name: Polytomic
tools.description: No-code data integration and reverse ETL platform
tools.longDescription: Polytomic is a no-code data integration platform that allows teams to sync data between databases, warehouses, and SaaS applications. It supports both forward and reverse ETL, enabling business teams to move data without engineering support. Features include bi-directional syncing, bulk operations, and real-time data activation.

tools.name: MuleSoft
tools.description: Enterprise integration platform for connecting apps, data, and devices
tools.longDescription: MuleSoft, a Salesforce company, provides the Anypoint Platform for API-led connectivity. It enables organizations to connect any application, data source, or device through APIs and integrations. The platform includes API design, development, management, and analytics tools used by thousands of enterprises worldwide.

tools.name: Boomi
tools.description: Cloud-native integration platform for connecting applications and data
tools.longDescription: Boomi is a cloud-native integration platform as a service (iPaaS) that connects applications, data, and people. Its AtomSphere platform provides integration, API management, master data management, B2B/EDI management, and workflow automation in a unified low-code environment used by over 20,000 customers.
tools.pricingDetails: Starts at $50/mo for basic; enterprise custom

tools.name: Workato
tools.description: AI-powered enterprise automation and integration platform
tools.longDescription: Workato is an enterprise automation platform that combines integration and workflow automation with AI. It enables both IT and business teams to build automated workflows (called recipes) across applications using a no-code interface. Features include intelligent automation, API management, and enterprise-grade security.
pros: Both IT and business user friendly

tools.name: Celigo
tools.description: Integration platform automating business processes across cloud applications
tools.longDescription: Celigo is an iPaaS that makes it easy to integrate cloud applications and automate business processes. Its integrator.io platform provides pre-built integrations, a visual flow builder, error management, and AI-assisted mapping. Popular for ERP-to-SaaS integrations, especially NetSuite-centric environments.
tools.pricingDetails: Free plan for 2 flows; Premium from $600/mo

tools.name: Sauce Labs
tools.description: Cloud-based testing platform for web and mobile applications
tools.longDescription: Sauce Labs provides the world's largest continuous testing cloud for web and mobile applications. It offers automated and manual testing across thousands of browser/OS/device combinations, with real device testing, visual testing, error reporting, and CI/CD integration. Used by major enterprises for quality assurance at scale.
tools.pricingDetails: Free trial; Team from $49/mo per user
cons: Pricing adds up for large teams
useCases: Mobile app testing on real devices

tools.name: CrossBrowserTesting
tools.description: Cloud platform for testing websites across browsers and devices
tools.longDescription: CrossBrowserTesting, by SmartBear, provides a cloud-based platform for testing websites and web applications across 2000+ real desktop and mobile browsers. Features include live interactive testing, automated screenshot comparisons, visual testing, and Selenium test execution with video recording and debugging tools.

tools.name: KeyCDN
tools.description: High-performance content delivery network with real-time analytics
tools.longDescription: KeyCDN is a high-performance content delivery network built for the future. It provides fast content delivery with 40+ PoPs worldwide, real-time analytics, instant purge, HTTP/2 support, free SSL, and DDoS protection. Known for transparent pay-as-you-go pricing starting at $0.04/GB.

tools.name: StackPath
tools.description: Edge computing and secure content delivery platform
tools.longDescription: StackPath is an edge computing platform that provides CDN, WAF, DNS, monitoring, and serverless scripting at the network edge. It helps businesses deliver fast, secure digital experiences with built-in security features including DDoS protection, bot management, and web application firewall capabilities.

tools.name: People.ai
tools.description: AI platform automating revenue intelligence and sales activity capture
tools.longDescription: People.ai is a revenue intelligence platform that uses AI to automate the capture of sales activities and provide data-driven insights. It automatically logs emails, calls, and meetings into CRM, maps buying groups, scores deal health, and provides coaching insights to help revenue teams close more deals.

tools.name: Qualified
tools.description: AI-powered pipeline generation platform for B2B sales
tools.longDescription: Qualified is an AI-powered pipeline generation platform built for Salesforce. It uses AI chatbots (Piper the AI SDR), live chat, meeting scheduling, and intent signals to convert website visitors into qualified pipeline. The platform identifies and engages high-value prospects in real-time directly on your website.

tools.name: Gladly
tools.description: People-centered customer service platform with AI capabilities
tools.longDescription: Gladly is a customer service platform that takes a radically personal approach by organizing support around customers rather than tickets. It provides a single lifelong conversation thread per customer across all channels, with AI-powered self-service, agent assistance, and routing to deliver personalized service at scale.

tools.name: Dixa
tools.description: Conversational customer service platform with AI-powered routing
tools.longDescription: Dixa is a conversational customer engagement platform that combines phone, email, chat, and messaging in one unified interface. Its AI-powered conversation engine routes customers to the right agent, provides real-time analytics, and offers intelligent self-service options. Known for its intuitive agent workspace.

tools.name: Chef Habitat
tools.description: Application automation platform for building, deploying, and managing apps
tools.longDescription: Chef Habitat is an open-source application automation framework that provides a consistent packaging, deployment, and management experience for any application on any platform. It wraps applications in lightweight, portable Habitat packages that include everything needed to run, with built-in health monitoring and service discovery.

tools.name: SaltStack
tools.description: Event-driven automation and configuration management platform
tools.longDescription: SaltStack (Salt Project) is an intelligent automation platform for managing and securing infrastructure at scale. It uses an event-driven architecture for configuration management, remote execution, cloud provisioning, and security compliance. Now part of VMware, Salt is known for its speed and scalability across large environments.
tools.pricingDetails: Open source; VMware Aria Automation pricing varies
pros: Scales to tens of thousands of nodes

tools.name: Buildium
tools.description: Property management software for residential property managers and associations
tools.longDescription: Buildium is an all-in-one property management platform that helps residential property managers handle accounting, maintenance, leasing, and tenant communication. It includes online rent collection, vacancy listing syndication, and resident portals for streamlined operations.
pros: Online rent collection and tenant portal

tools.name: Toast POS
tools.description: Restaurant point-of-sale and management platform built for the food service industry
tools.longDescription: Toast is an all-in-one restaurant technology platform combining POS hardware, online ordering, payroll, team management, and marketing. Designed specifically for restaurants, it handles tableside ordering, kitchen display systems, and detailed menu management.
tools.founder: Steve Fredette, Aman Narang, Jonathan Grimm

tools.name: Dentrix
tools.description: Dental practice management software for clinical and business operations
tools.longDescription: Dentrix is a comprehensive dental practice management system used by thousands of dental offices. It manages patient records, scheduling, insurance claims processing, treatment planning, digital imaging integration, and practice analytics all within one platform.
tools.pricingDetails: Contact for pricing, varies by practice size

tools.name: Vetspire
tools.longDescription: Vetspire is a modern, cloud-based veterinary practice management system that uses AI to streamline clinical workflows. It offers smart medical records with auto-population, integrated telehealth, client communication tools, and comprehensive practice analytics designed specifically for veterinary clinics.
useCases: AI-assisted medical records and SOAP notes

tools.name: Planning Center
tools.description: Church management software for worship planning and volunteer coordination
tools.longDescription: Planning Center is a suite of church management apps covering service planning, people management, giving, check-in, groups, and registration. It helps churches organize worship services, coordinate volunteers, manage donations, and track membership with purpose-built tools.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for small churches, paid plans from $14/mo per app
cons: Costs add up with multiple apps

tools.name: Gymdesk
tools.description: Gym and fitness studio management software with member tracking
tools.longDescription: Gymdesk is a gym management platform that handles member sign-ups, attendance tracking, class scheduling, billing, and access control. It provides a member portal, automated billing, and detailed reporting for fitness studios, martial arts schools, and CrossFit boxes.

tools.name: PowerDNS
tools.description: Open-source authoritative DNS server and recursor
tools.longDescription: PowerDNS is a high-performance open-source DNS server suite consisting of an authoritative server and a recursor. It supports various backends including SQL databases, LDAP, and plain files, and includes a modern HTTP API for management and DNSSEC support.

tools.name: Quay
tools.description: Container image registry with security scanning and access controls
tools.longDescription: Quay is a container image registry developed by Red Hat that provides secure storage, distribution, and scanning of container images. It features automated security vulnerability scanning with Clair, image signing, geo-replication, and fine-grained access controls for enterprise container workflows.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for public repos, paid plans from $15/mo
pros: Strong access control and audit logging
cons: Fewer community integrations than Docker Hub
Self-hosted version requires Red Hat subscription

tools.name: CoCounsel
tools.description: AI legal assistant powered by GPT-4 for legal research and analysis
tools.longDescription: CoCounsel by Thomson Reuters is an AI-powered legal assistant that helps lawyers with document review, legal research, contract analysis, and deposition preparation. It uses advanced AI to search case law, summarize legal documents, and identify relevant precedents.
pros: Powered by GPT-4 for accurate legal analysis
cons: Requires legal domain knowledge to use effectively
useCases: Legal research and case law analysis

tools.name: Suki AI
tools.description: AI voice assistant for clinical documentation and medical notes
tools.longDescription: Suki AI is an AI-powered voice assistant designed for physicians that creates clinical documentation through natural conversation. It learns each doctor's preferences, auto-populates note templates, generates referral letters, and integrates directly with EHR systems to reduce documentation burden.

tools.name: Rex CRM
tools.description: Real estate CRM and agency management platform
tools.longDescription: Rex is a cloud-based real estate CRM designed for agencies and agents to manage listings, contacts, and deals. It provides lead management, automated marketing workflows, property matching, and performance analytics tailored specifically for the real estate industry.

tools.name: Botkeeper
tools.description: AI-powered bookkeeping platform for accounting firms
tools.longDescription: Botkeeper combines AI, machine learning, and skilled accountants to deliver automated bookkeeping services. It handles transaction categorization, bank reconciliation, financial reporting, and month-end close processes, designed primarily for accounting firms managing multiple clients.
cons: Setup and migration can be lengthy
Best suited for firms not solo practitioners

tools.name: Fieldwire
tools.description: Construction project management and field collaboration platform
tools.longDescription: Fieldwire is a construction management platform that connects the field and office with task management, plan viewing, punch lists, inspections, and real-time reporting. Used on over 1 million projects, it helps construction teams track tasks, manage blueprints, and ensure quality control.
tools.pricingDetails: Basic free, Pro $39/user/mo, Business $59/user/mo, Premier custom
pros: Powerful task and punch list management
cons: Large plan files can be slow

tools.name: Cropio
tools.description: Precision agriculture platform for farm management and crop monitoring
tools.longDescription: Cropio is a cloud-based precision agriculture platform that uses satellite imagery, weather data, and field scouting to help farmers monitor crop health, plan field operations, and optimize inputs. It provides vegetation indices, growth stage tracking, and yield forecasting for data-driven farm management.

tools.name: Samsara
tools.description: IoT platform for fleet management, equipment monitoring, and site safety
tools.longDescription: Samsara is a connected operations platform that uses IoT sensors, cameras, and software to improve fleet safety, vehicle tracking, equipment monitoring, and compliance. It provides real-time GPS tracking, AI-powered dash cams, driver coaching, and electronic logging device (ELD) compliance.
pros: Comprehensive IoT platform covering fleet and facilities
cons: Hardware costs add up for large fleets

tools.name: Pixquare
tools.description: Pixel art creation app with animation and tiling tools
tools.longDescription: Pixquare is a dedicated pixel art editor for iPad and iPhone that provides professional-grade tools for creating pixel art, sprites, and animations. It features layers, animation timeline, tile mode for seamless patterns, palette management, and export to sprite sheets.
pros: Professional pixel art tools on iPad
Tile mode for seamless pattern creation
cons: Free version has canvas size limits

tools.name: PatternNodes
tools.description: Node-based pattern design software for repeating designs and textiles
tools.longDescription: PatternNodes is a node-based design tool for creating vector patterns, animations, and repeating designs. It uses a non-destructive node graph approach where users connect shape generators, transformers, and repeaters to create complex geometric patterns for textiles, wallpapers, and print design.
pros: Exports to vector and raster formats
cons: Steep learning curve for node-based design

tools.name: Boom Library
tools.description: Professional sound effects library for film, games, and media production
tools.longDescription: Boom Library provides high-definition, royalty-free sound effects collections for film, TV, game audio, and media production. Their libraries cover cinematic impacts, creatures, vehicles, nature ambiences, sci-fi elements, and construction sounds, recorded at professional quality.

tools.name: Dirac Live
tools.description: Room correction software for optimizing audio playback environments
tools.longDescription: Dirac Live is a room correction platform that analyzes acoustic measurements and applies digital filters to correct frequency response and timing issues in any listening environment. Used by audio professionals, home theater enthusiasts, and car audio manufacturers for precise sound optimization.
tools.pricingDetails: Dirac Live from $99, Bass Control $249 add-on
pros: Used by major speaker and AV manufacturers
cons: Higher tiers expensive for home users

tools.name: Kandao Studio
tools.longDescription: Kandao Studio is a professional 360-degree video editing application for stitching, stabilizing, and editing immersive VR content. It supports 8K resolution, AI-powered stitching, HDR processing, and batch rendering for content captured with Kandao and other 360 cameras.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for Kandao cameras, Pro $149/year for third-party cameras

tools.name: Depthkit
tools.description: Volumetric video capture and production toolkit
tools.longDescription: Depthkit is a volumetric video capture platform that creates 3D video assets from depth sensor recordings. It enables filmmakers and creators to capture real people and performances as volumetric content that can be viewed from any angle in AR, VR, and interactive media applications.
pros: Accessible volumetric capture with consumer depth sensors
Integrates with Unity and Unreal Engine

tools.name: disguise
tools.description: Virtual production and real-time visualization platform
tools.longDescription: disguise is a virtual production platform used for film, broadcast, live events, and immersive experiences. It powers LED wall virtual production with camera tracking, real-time rendering, and content management for in-camera VFX workflows used by major studios.
tools.pricingDetails: Hardware and software licensing, contact for pricing
pros: Industry standard for LED virtual production
Trusted by major film studios and broadcasters

tools.name: Galaxy Project
tools.description: Web-based bioinformatics platform for accessible data analysis
tools.longDescription: Galaxy is an open-source, web-based platform for data-intensive biomedical research. It provides thousands of bioinformatics tools for genomics, proteomics, and other life science analyses through an accessible graphical interface, making computational biology available without command-line expertise.
tools.pricingDetails: Free and open-source, public servers available
pros: Free public servers with compute resources
cons: Public servers can have queue times
Large datasets may need private instances

tools.name: Foldit
tools.description: Citizen science game for protein structure prediction and design
tools.longDescription: Foldit is a scientific puzzle game where players fold protein structures to solve real-world biochemistry problems. Developed by the University of Washington, it gamifies protein folding research, allowing citizen scientists to contribute to drug design and disease research.
pros: Contributions have led to published papers

tools.name: En-ROADS
tools.description: Climate change solutions simulator for policy exploration
tools.longDescription: En-ROADS is an interactive climate simulator developed by Climate Interactive and MIT Sloan that allows users to explore the impact of energy, economic, and land-use policies on global climate outcomes. It models relationships between policy choices and temperature change through 2100.
cons: Simplified models vs full climate simulations
Global focus may miss regional nuances

tools.name: Weave
tools.description: Unified communication platform for dental and healthcare practices
tools.longDescription: Weave is an all-in-one communication platform for dental, optometry, and veterinary practices. It combines phone systems, text messaging, email marketing, online scheduling, payment processing, and review management into a single platform with deep practice management software integration.
cons: Monthly cost can be high for small practices

tools.name: Doctible
tools.description: Patient engagement and marketing platform for healthcare practices
tools.longDescription: Doctible is a patient engagement platform helping healthcare practices attract, communicate with, and retain patients. It provides online reputation management, patient reminders, digital intake forms, two-way texting, and automated marketing campaigns specifically designed for medical and dental offices.
cons: Per-location pricing adds up for multi-site

tools.name: Clio
tools.longDescription: Clio is the leading cloud-based legal practice management platform used by over 150,000 law professionals. It handles case management, time tracking, billing, document management, client intake, and trust accounting, providing a complete operating system for law firms of all sizes.
cons: Per-user pricing adds up for larger firms

tools.name: SimplyBook.me
tools.description: Online appointment scheduling and booking system
tools.longDescription: SimplyBook.me is a versatile online booking platform that allows businesses to accept appointments, manage schedules, and process payments. It supports multiple service providers, custom booking pages, client management, and integrates with popular calendar and payment systems.
tools.pricingDetails: Free up to 50 bookings/mo, Basic $9.90/mo, Standard $29.90/mo, Premium $59.90/mo
pros: Wide range of custom features and add-ons

tools.name: Sortly
tools.description: Visual inventory management app for businesses and personal use
tools.longDescription: Sortly is an intuitive inventory management app that uses photos, QR codes, and barcodes to track items across locations. It simplifies inventory with visual organization, custom fields, low stock alerts, and reporting, designed for businesses that need straightforward asset tracking without complex ERP systems.
tools.pricingDetails: Free up to 100 items, Advanced $49/mo, Ultra $149/mo, Enterprise custom
pros: Custom fields and folders for organization

tools.name: LinkedIn Learning
tools.description: Professional development courses powered by LinkedIn's career data and AI-driven recommendations.
tools.longDescription: LinkedIn Learning offers thousands of expert-led courses in business, technology, and creative skills. The platform leverages LinkedIn profile data to recommend personalized learning paths, tracks skill development with certificates, and integrates directly with your professional profile to showcase completed courses to employers.

tools.name: MasterClass
tools.description: Celebrity-taught online classes in cooking, writing, filmmaking, music, and more.
tools.longDescription: MasterClass features world-renowned experts teaching their craft through cinematic-quality video lessons. From Gordon Ramsay on cooking to Martin Scorsese on filmmaking, each class includes pre-recorded video lessons, downloadable workbooks, and community discussions. The platform focuses on inspiration and storytelling alongside practical skills.

tools.name: Domestika
tools.description: Creative online courses taught by top professionals in design, illustration, photography, and crafts.
tools.longDescription: Domestika is the largest creative community offering affordable, high-quality courses in illustration, design, photography, marketing, crafts, and more. Courses are project-based with lifetime access, downloadable resources, and an active community forum. The platform supports multiple languages and features courses from creative professionals worldwide.
cons: No subscription model for unlimited access

tools.name: Skillshare
tools.description: Online learning community with thousands of classes in creative, business, and tech skills.
tools.longDescription: Skillshare is a creative learning platform offering thousands of short, project-based classes in illustration, design, photography, video, freelancing, and more. The platform emphasizes hands-on learning through class projects, peer feedback, and community interaction. Teachers earn revenue based on watch time, creating a diverse catalog of practical courses.

tools.name: Almanac
tools.description: AI-powered document management platform for modern teams with templates, workflows, and version control.
tools.longDescription: Almanac is a document platform designed for distributed teams. It combines document creation with built-in approval workflows, version control, and a library of 10,000+ templates. Teams use Almanac to create handbooks, SOPs, proposals, and any structured document with AI assistance, collaborative editing, and governance features.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for individuals; Team plans from $12/user/month

tools.name: ChurnZero
tools.description: Real-time customer success platform that helps subscription businesses fight churn and expand revenue.
tools.longDescription: ChurnZero provides a comprehensive customer success platform that integrates with your tech stack to give a 360-degree view of customers. It features health scores, automated playbooks, in-app communications, journey mapping, and renewal forecasting. The platform helps CS teams proactively identify at-risk accounts and drive product adoption.
tools.pricingDetails: Custom pricing based on customer count
cons: Steep learning curve for full features

tools.name: Totango
tools.description: Customer success platform with modular SuccessBLOCs for driving adoption, retention, and expansion.
tools.longDescription: Totango offers a composable customer success platform built around modular SuccessBLOCs — pre-built programs for onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. The platform provides customer health monitoring, automated workflows, segmentation, and integrations with your existing tech stack to help CS teams scale their impact.
tools.pricingDetails: Free Community plan; Enterprise plans custom pricing
bestFor: customer success teams needing modular workflows

tools.name: Catalyst
tools.description: Modern customer success platform built for simplicity with AI-driven insights and workflow automation.
tools.longDescription: Catalyst is a customer success platform that combines CRM data, product usage, and support interactions into a single workspace. It features AI-powered health scores, customizable dashboards, automated playbooks, and deep integrations. Designed to be intuitive, Catalyst helps CS teams manage their book of business without complex configuration.
pros: Intuitive and easy to set up
bestFor: growing SaaS companies building CS teams
customer success managers needing a unified view
revenue teams aligning on account health

tools.name: Planhat
tools.description: Customer platform combining success, experience, and revenue management for B2B companies.
tools.longDescription: Planhat is a customer platform that unifies customer success, product analytics, and revenue management. It provides 360-degree customer views, health scores, playbooks, revenue tracking, and powerful data modeling. The platform is built for B2B companies that want a single source of truth for all customer-related data and workflows.
cons: Can be complex for small teams
Fewer native integrations than US competitors
bestFor: B2B SaaS companies in growth stage

tools.name: Teamtailor
tools.description: Employer branding and recruitment platform with a beautiful career site builder and ATS.
tools.longDescription: Teamtailor combines an applicant tracking system with a powerful career site builder and employer branding tools. Companies use it to create stunning career pages, manage candidates through customizable pipelines, automate recruiting workflows, and build their employer brand. The platform emphasizes design and candidate experience.

tools.name: Breezy HR
tools.description: Visual recruiting platform with drag-and-drop pipelines, automated scheduling, and candidate management.
tools.longDescription: Breezy HR offers an intuitive, visually-driven recruiting experience with drag-and-drop Kanban-style candidate pipelines. It includes automated interview scheduling, candidate scorecards, background checks, offer management, and job board distribution. The platform is designed to be easy to set up and use for teams of all sizes.

tools.name: Workable
tools.description: AI-powered recruiting platform with sourcing, hiring, and onboarding in one system.
tools.longDescription: Workable is a comprehensive recruiting platform that uses AI to help companies find, evaluate, and hire great talent. It features AI-powered candidate sourcing, one-click job posting to 200+ boards, video interviews, automated assessments, and built-in onboarding. The platform serves over 27,000 companies and handles millions of candidates annually.
cons: Some features locked to higher tiers
bestFor: companies of all sizes hiring actively

tools.name: Airmeet
tools.description: Virtual and hybrid event platform with networking lounges, stages, and interactive features.
tools.longDescription: Airmeet is a virtual and hybrid event platform built for engagement. It features virtual stages, networking lounges with video tables, Q&A, polls, breakout rooms, and expo booths. The platform supports webinars, conferences, workshops, and community meetups with a focus on creating meaningful networking opportunities and interactive experiences.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for up to 100 attendees; Pro from $99/month
cons: Can lag with very large audiences

tools.name: Run The World
tools.description: Social event platform for interactive online events with unique round-table networking.
tools.longDescription: Run The World is a social events platform that recreates the magic of in-person events online. It features a unique round-table networking format where attendees are grouped at virtual tables for face-to-face conversations. The platform supports ticketed events, speaker sessions, breakout discussions, and provides tools for event monetization.

tools.name: Olark
tools.description: Simple and effective live chat software for sales and customer support with real-time visitor insights.
tools.longDescription: Olark provides straightforward live chat software that helps businesses talk to customers in real time. It features customizable chat widgets, automated messages, visitor insights, chat transcripts, and team management tools. The platform integrates with popular CRM and helpdesk tools to keep all customer conversations connected.
pros: Simple and easy to set up
bestFor: support teams wanting simple chat tools

tools.name: PDF24
tools.description: Free online PDF tools for converting, compressing, merging, and editing PDF files.
tools.longDescription: PDF24 offers a comprehensive suite of free PDF tools available both online and as a desktop application. Users can merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, and protect PDF files without creating an account. The platform processes files locally for privacy and offers over 30 different PDF operations completely free of charge.

tools.name: Sejda
tools.description: Online PDF editor with editing, signing, and form-filling capabilities directly in the browser.
tools.longDescription: Sejda is an online PDF editor that allows users to edit text and images directly in PDF files, fill out forms, add signatures, merge, split, compress, and convert documents. It offers both a web app and desktop versions with a focus on actual PDF content editing rather than just conversion. Files are automatically deleted from servers after processing.
pros: Direct PDF text and image editing
cons: Free tier limited to 3 tasks per day
bestFor: users needing to edit PDF content directly

tools.name: PDFsam
tools.description: Open-source PDF split and merge tool with a free desktop application and visual document organizer.
tools.longDescription: PDFsam (PDF Split and Merge) is an open-source desktop application for splitting, merging, rotating, and extracting pages from PDF files. The basic version is completely free and open source, while PDFsam Enhanced offers additional features like PDF editing, converting, and form filling. It processes files locally without uploading to servers.
tools.pricingDetails: Basic free and open-source; Enhanced from $39/year
cons: UI is functional but not modern
bestFor: users wanting free offline PDF tools

tools.name: Fishbowl
tools.description: Inventory management and warehouse solution designed for QuickBooks and Xero users.
tools.longDescription: Fishbowl is an inventory management solution that integrates deeply with QuickBooks and Xero. It provides manufacturing, warehouse management, barcode scanning, asset tracking, and multi-location inventory control. The platform is designed for small to mid-size businesses that need more inventory power than their accounting software provides.

tools.name: Ordoro
tools.description: Shipping and inventory management platform for e-commerce businesses with multi-carrier support.
tools.longDescription: Ordoro simplifies shipping and inventory management for e-commerce sellers. It provides multi-carrier shipping label printing, inventory syncing across sales channels, dropshipping automation, purchase order management, and kitting. The platform is designed to help growing e-commerce businesses streamline their fulfillment operations.

tools.name: Setmore
tools.description: Free online appointment scheduling software with booking pages, reminders, and payment processing.
tools.longDescription: Setmore is a free appointment scheduling platform that provides online booking pages, automated reminders, staff management, and payment processing. Businesses create a customizable booking page where clients can self-schedule appointments. It includes a calendar, customer database, video meeting integration, and supports multiple staff members.
tools.pricingDetails: Free for up to 4 staff; Pro from $5/user/month
cons: Mobile app could be more polished

tools.name: Booksy
tools.description: Booking and business management platform built specifically for beauty and wellness professionals.
tools.longDescription: Booksy is a booking and business management platform designed for beauty and wellness professionals — barbers, hairstylists, nail technicians, and spa owners. It provides appointment scheduling, client management, point-of-sale, marketing tools, and a consumer marketplace where clients discover and book services. The platform serves over 20 million users worldwide.
cons: Can be expensive for solo providers
bestFor: salons and spas running their business
useCases: Online presence and discovery for providers

tools.name: Matillion
tools.description: Data integration and transformation platform for cloud data warehouses
tools.longDescription: Matillion is a data integration and transformation platform purpose-built for cloud data warehouses. It provides a low-code/no-code interface for ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) pipelines, enabling data teams to quickly build, orchestrate, and schedule data transformation workflows directly in Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, and Databricks.
tools.pricingDetails: Free tier available; Enterprise custom pricing

tools.name: Stitch Data
tools.description: Simple cloud-based ETL service for data pipeline automation
tools.longDescription: Stitch, a Talend product, is a simple cloud-based ETL service that moves data from 130+ sources into data warehouses, data lakes, and databases. It provides zero-maintenance data pipelines with automatic schema detection, incremental replication, and a developer-friendly API for building custom integrations.
tools.pricingDetails: Free plan for up to 10M rows/mo; Standard from $100/mo

tools.name: Confluent
tools.description: Enterprise data streaming platform built on Apache Kafka
tools.longDescription: Confluent is the enterprise data streaming platform founded by the original creators of Apache Kafka. Confluent Cloud provides a fully managed Kafka service with stream processing (ksqlDB and Flink), connectors, governance, and real-time data pipelines. It powers event-driven architectures for the world's largest enterprises.

tools.name: Dremio
tools.description: Data lakehouse platform with SQL query engine for analytics
tools.longDescription: Dremio is an open data lakehouse platform that provides a unified SQL query engine for data lake analytics. It enables data teams to run BI dashboards, ad-hoc queries, and data science workloads directly on data lakes without copying data. Features include Apache Iceberg integration, data reflections, and semantic layer capabilities.
tools.pricingDetails: Community Edition free; Enterprise custom pricing

tools.name: Cube
tools.description: Headless BI and semantic layer for data applications
tools.longDescription: Cube is an open-source headless BI platform that provides a semantic layer, caching, and access control for building data applications. It sits between your data warehouse and downstream applications, providing a universal API for consistent metrics, governed data access, and optimized query performance across any front-end tool.

tools.name: Preset
tools.description: Managed cloud platform for Apache Superset business intelligence
tools.longDescription: Preset is a fully managed cloud BI platform built on top of Apache Superset. It provides enterprise-ready data exploration and visualization without the overhead of self-hosting.
